#### ACODE-01 · اختبار حدود الحقن وتسليم القرار للبشر · Agent injection boundary and human-handoff tests · 📄 موصوف / documented only

- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Hardening agents that read email, documents or tool output.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Plant benign canary instructions in documents. 2) Check agent ignores them. 3) Define escalation triggers with evidence preserved. 4) Gate review actions behind human approval. **أرقام / params:** agent, corpus

#### ACODE-02 · فحص أمان مسبق للوكيل بإيصال أخضر/أصفر/أحمر · Agent safety preflight with Green/Yellow/Red receipt · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يفحص ملفات المستودع المحلية بحثًا عن أوامر مدمّرة وأتمتة تكتب بيانات اعتماد وصلاحيات وكيل واسعة قبل التعديل، ويعيد إيصال مخاطر جاهزًا مع الخطوة الآمنة التالية. — Scan a repository's local files for destructive commands, credential-writing automation and over-broad agent authority before agent edits, and return a pasteable risk receipt with the next safe action.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User asks to prepare a repo for agent changes, check for risky hooks, set agent permissions or autonomy levels, or says run agent preflight / check this repo before edits.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Confirm repo path; read only local docs/config; send nothing outside. 2) Run the lightweight scanner from a trusted root, else apply manual rules. 3) Inspect high-signal paths first: .claude/, .cursor/, .github/, shell scripts, JSON/YAML/TOML config, package manifests, env files. 4) Classify: Green = clean git, no markers; Yellow = hooks, broad tool permissions or git state unavailable (checkpoint or narrow scope first); Red = recursive delete or credential writing in an agent-controlled path (stop for human review). 5) Receipt: Decision, Repository, Git state, Risk buckets, Evidence, Next safe action. 6) Set permission and autonomy level per task type. **أرقام / params:** repo path; strictness; autonomy level policy
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1918-agent-safety-preflight/7058-agent-safety-preflight` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3049-adlc-govern/13121-agent-permissions` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3045-adlc-agent-engineering/13086-agent-runtime-guardrails`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): agent-safety-preflight/agent-safety-preflight (#7058); adlc-govern/agent-permissions (#13121); adlc-agent-engineering/agent-runtime-guardrails (#13086) · theme agent-workflow · 7 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/1918-agent-safety-preflight/7058-agent-safety-preflight, skills/3049-adlc-govern/13121-agent-permissions, skills/3045-adlc-agent-engineering/13086-agent-runtime-guardrails

#### ACODE-03 · تدقيق سجلات جلسات الوكلاء بحثًا عن أسرار مسرّبة · Audit agent transcripts for leaked credentials · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يمسح كل مواضع جلسات الوكلاء على القرص بحثًا عن أسرار مسرّبة دون إعادة تسريبها، ويقيّم الخطورة، ثم يدوّر السر أولًا وينظّف ثانيًا بالبصمات فقط. — Sweep every on-disk agent session surface for leaked secrets without re-leaking them, triage severity, rotate first and scrub second using fingerprints only.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Auditing whether secrets ended up in Claude Code/Codex session files, a credential is suspected leaked, rotating a shared credential, or scrubbing transcripts after rotation.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Sweep every surface: projects/**/*.jsonl, file-history, prompt history, hook logs, other agents' homes, `*.jsonl.deleted.*` tombstones, editor backups. 2) `rg -uu --no-messages -o -a` with prefix-anchored patterns (AWS AKIA/ASIA, Slack xox, npm_, private-key headers); without -uu rg silently reports clean. 3) Drop noise: node_modules, redaction fixtures, docs example keys, temp STS creds. 4) Report file + status + sha256[:10] fingerprint, never the value; never put a secret on argv. 5) Severity: key id alone is housekeeping, id plus secret is an incident; probe liveness non-destructively. 6) Rotate outside any transcribed session, then scrub by a kill-list of verified-dead fingerprints. **أرقام / params:** agent home dirs; credential classes; fingerprint kill-list
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3262-agent-session-credential-audit/13773-agent-session-credential-audit` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3260-agent-credential-leak-surfaces/13771-agent-credential-leak-surfaces` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1559-agent-guard/4323-setup-agent-guard`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): agent-session-credential-audit/agent-session-credential-audit (#13773); agent-credential-leak-surfaces/agent-credential-leak-surfaces (#13771); agent-guard/setup-agent-guard (#4323) · theme agent-workflow · 4 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/3262-agent-session-credential-audit/13773-agent-session-credential-audit, skills/3260-agent-credential-leak-surfaces/13771-agent-credential-leak-surfaces, skills/1559-agent-guard/4323-setup-agent-guard

#### ACODE-04 · كتابة وفحص سكربتات سير عمل متعددة الوكلاء · Author and lint deterministic multi-agent workflow scripts · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إجراء مقابلة تحديد المتطلبات ثم توليد هيكل سكربت سير العمل وفحصه قبل التشغيل. — Run intake, scaffold a topology (fan-out, pipeline, loop, judge-panel), and lint the .js workflow for resume-breaking mistakes.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User wants to orchestrate sub-agents in a fixed, resumable topology.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ask unit of work, unit count, need-all-results, structured output. 2) Pick topology; default to pipeline unless a stage needs the full prior set. 3) Meta block as a pure literal first statement. 4) No Date.now/Math.random/fs in orchestrator; pass timestamps via args. 5) parallel() takes thunks; filter(Boolean) results. 6) Guard loops with counter or budget check (1000-agent cap). 7) Lint then run. **أرقام / params:** topology, task description

#### ACODE-05 · مقارنة وكلاء البرمجة في أشجار عمل معزولة · Benchmark Claude Code vs Codex in isolated worktrees · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مقارنة وكلاء البرمجة على نفس الطلب ونفس الالتزام الابتدائي ونفس فحص النتيجة داخل أشجار عمل مؤقتة، ثم تجميع الوقت والرموز والتكلفة وبوابات النجاح في تقرير واحد. — Compare coding agents on the same prompt, starting commit and outcome check using disposable git worktrees, then aggregate time, tokens, cost and pass/fail gates into one report.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Choosing between agents or models for a repo task; measuring a prompt or skill change; need defensible time and cost numbers rather than impressions.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Write a repo-level TOML config: prompt file, start branch or commit, agent list, an outer check (proves the real outcome before and after, and times it) and an inner check (fast feedback for the agent). 2) Require a clean repo, installed CLIs and a passing outer check. 3) Confirm agents and a run ID, then run trials sequentially so load does not bias timing: run_trial.py --repo --config --agent --run. 4) Results land in eval-results/<task>/<agent>/run-<id>-<timestamp>/ on result branches; never commit on the user's branch. 5) Aggregate with parse_transcript.py --aggregate ... --output comparison.json --render-report comparison.md; never rank a failed trial. **أرقام / params:** prompt path; start_branch or start_commit; agents; outer_check; inner_check; run id
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`python3`](../requirements.md#req-python3) · [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2992-development-skills/12679-ai-agent-bench` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2818-codex-subagent/11438-codex-subagent-driven-development`

#### ACODE-07 · مرشحون متنافسون في worktrees ثم دمج الفائز · Competing worktree candidates, judged, one landed · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يشغّل عدة وكلاء مستقلين على المهمة نفسها في worktrees معزولة، ويرتّبهم بمقياس رقمي أو حكم نموذج أعمى، ثم يدمج فائزًا واحدًا فقط ويؤرشف الباقين. — Run N independent agents on the same task in isolated git worktrees, rank them by a metric or blind LLM judge, merge exactly one winner and archive the rest.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User wants several approaches tried in parallel (optimization, refactor, test-writing, bug-fix alternatives, copy variants) or a tournament/A-B comparison of drafts.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Init a session: config (task, N, eval criteria) plus a state machine INIT -> DISPATCH -> MONITOR -> EVALUATE -> MERGE and message-board channels (dispatch/progress/results). 2) Read-only preflight of what the repo can support before spending tokens; record a baseline. 3) Launch all N in ONE message via the Agent tool with `isolation: worktree`, each told to commit and write a result note. 4) Evaluate: metric mode runs the eval command in each worktree and parses a number; judge mode ranks diffs; hybrid uses the judge for ties. 5) `git merge --no-ff` the winner, tag losers (e.g. `hub/archive/<session>/agent-<i>`), remove worktrees, post a summary. **أرقام / params:** N candidates; eval command + metric direction, or judge rubric; template (optimizer/refactorer/test-writer/bug-fixer)
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git) · [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/155-agenthub/512-agenthub` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/250-arbeitsplan/803-arbeitsplan-run` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/250-arbeitsplan/801-arbeitsplan-patterns`

#### ACODE-08 · تنسيق وكلاء أشجار العمل عبر رسائل وإيصالات · Coordinate worktree coding agents via mail and receipts · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** منع التداخل بين وكلاء البرمجة في أشجار عمل git منفصلة عبر تبادل سجلات رسائل (حقائق ومقترحات ملكية وتقارير حالة وتفويضات وإقرارات) مع جرس من سطر واحد وإيصالات مسجلة. — Prevent overlap between coding agents in separate git worktrees by exchanging mailbox message records (facts, ownership proposals, state reports, authorizations, acknowledgements) with a one-line doorbell and recorded receipts.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Several coding agents may touch the same files, depend on each other or share an external blocker; ownership must be negotiated; agent sessions must be recovered after a multiplexer restart.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Register a mail identity per agent; derive the project key and build commands only through the provided wrapper script, never by hand. 2) Before work, check overlap in files, dependencies and external blockers. 3) Send ownership proposals and state reports as message records, then ring a one-line doorbell in the recipient pane. 4) Recipient reads its inbox and records a receipt. 5) Pane operations (inventory, bounded wait, prompt, start, relaunch, stop, worktree create/open) go through wrapper skills. 6) Start the Executor session for a Change only via its orchestrate skill. 7) Before restarting the multiplexer, prepare an exact-session manifest and recover from it. **أرقام / params:** agent names; message type; project key; session manifest
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2779-coding-agents/11058-coordinate-agents` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2779-coding-agents/11060-operate-agent-mail` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2779-coding-agents/11062-operate-prowl`

#### ACODE-09 · تفويض المهام لوكيل آخر مع بوابة مراجعة · Delegate to Codex or Claude with review gate · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تسليم مهمة محددة للتنفيذ أو النقد أو التشخيص إلى بيئة وكيل برمجة أخرى (Codex CLI أو مهمة Claude Code متتبَّعة أو ZCode) انطلاقاً من خطة مكتوبة، ثم مراجعة التغييرات بنموذج ثانٍ قبل القبول. — Hand a bounded implementation, critique or diagnosis task to another coding-agent runtime (Codex CLI, a tracked Claude Code job, ZCode) from a written plan, then have a second model review the diff before accepting it.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** A second opinion or a different model is wanted; work should run in the background in another CLI; reviewing a plan or diff with a different vendor; keeping the main agent's judgment while offloading execution.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Put the task and acceptance checks in a prompt file from a written plan. 2) Choose runtime and flags: background or wait, resume or fresh, write permission, model, effort level. 3) Dispatch the other runtime as implementer or reviewer; have the controller prepare an isolated git worktree. 4) Follow live progress by job id and resume instead of restarting. 5) Second-model review gate: a different model critiques the diff against the plan. 6) The main agent keeps judgment and decides to accept or reject; no auto-merge. Flags and bridge behaviour taken from skill descriptions only. **أرقام / params:** runtime (codex|claude|zcode); model; effort (low..max); background/wait; prompt file; write permission
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git)

#### ACODE-10 · أنماط سير عمل دائم: ساجا وDAG · Durable workflow patterns: Temporal sagas and Airflow DAGs · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم سير عمل طويل ومتحمل للأعطال بفصل الـ workflow عن الـ activity وساجا تعويضية وإعادة محاولات ومهلًا، ثم يشخّصه ويختبره عبر واجهات المحرك نفسه. — Design long-running, failure-tolerant workflows with workflow/activity separation, compensating sagas, retries and timeouts, then debug and test them through the engine's own APIs.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Building multi-step distributed transactions without 2PC, long-running processes, or authoring, debugging and end-to-end testing Amazon MWAA/Airflow workflows.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Separate deterministic workflow code from side-effecting activities and respect determinism constraints. 2) For cross-service transactions define a compensating action per step (saga) and the order of undo. 3) For Airflow: pick operators deliberately, set timeouts, retry strategy, schedule and failure notifications. 4) Deploy the artifact (Python DAG on provisioned, YAML on serverless). 5) Test by triggering a run and watching it to completion. 6) Debug failures from environment details, REST API (`aws mwaa invoke-rest-api`) and CloudWatch logs. **أرقام / params:** engine (Temporal/MWAA); step list with compensations; retry and timeout policy

#### ACODE-11 · حلقة تطوير محلية ببيانات وهمية واختبار حي اختياري · Fixture-first local dev loop with opt-in live test · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** بناء تكامل مع واجهة مورّد مدفوعة أو تتطلب اعتماداً خلف محوّل رفيع يعتمد افتراضياً على بيانات اصطناعية، ويجعل أي حركة حية اختباراً دخانياً صريحاً ومحدوداً بقرار المستخدم. — Build an integration against a paid or credentialed vendor API behind a thin adapter that defaults to synthetic fixtures and makes any live traffic an explicit, bounded opt-in smoke test.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Implementing parsers, retry classification, async job or webhook handling for a vendor SDK without spending credits or touching production data; requests like 'mock the API locally' or 'offline test loop'.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Wrap the vendor SDK in a thin provider adapter. 2) Default every test run to synthetic or contract fixtures: no network, no credits. 3) Cover parsers, retry classification, async snapshot or job handling and callbacks offline against those fixtures. 4) Make live calls a separate opt-in smoke test (explicit command or env flag), tiny and bounded. 5) For OAuth vendors use a dedicated development integration, never production credentials. 6) In tool-use loops keep JSON-schema validation, explicit dispatch, result correlation and approval gates. Pattern taken from templated 'pack' descriptions. **أرقام / params:** vendor; fixture location; live-test flag name; credential scope

#### ACODE-12 · حلقة مهام بوكلاء جدد ومراجعة مرحلتين · Fresh-subagent task loop with two-stage review · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تنفيذ خطة بوكيل جديد لكل مهمة والتزام واحد لكل مهمة ومراجعة المطابقة ثم الجودة. — Execute a plan or todo queue with one fresh-context subagent per task, one commit each, and spec review before quality review.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Executing implementation plans with independent tasks; processing a whole .llm/todo.md queue.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Confirm subagent spawn tool exists, leave plan mode. 2) Leader only coordinates (Bash, spawn), never implements. 3) Extract next task, record HEAD. 4) Spawn fresh implementer (TDD, self-check, commit). 5) Spec-compliance reviewer, then code-quality reviewer; fail loops back to fix. 6) Verify HEAD advanced by exactly one commit and worktree clean. 7) Mark failed tasks blocked, never retry twice; run sequentially when sharing worktree. **أرقام / params:** plan file, max tasks
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git) · [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)

#### ACODE-13 · عزل أوامر الوكيل على macOS بـ Seatbelt · macOS Seatbelt confinement for agent commands · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** حصر أوامر الوكيل في شجرة مجلد واحدة باستخدام sandbox-exec مع غلاف يفشل مغلقا. — Confine agent shell commands to one directory tree using sandbox-exec with realpath carve-outs and a fail-closed wrapper.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Agent cwd policy is not enough; symlink escapes; getcwd or /private/tmp denials under sandbox.
- **كيف / how:** 1) sandbox-exec -p profile /bin/sh -c cmd. 2) Profile: allow default, global write deny, read deny under /Users and /Volumes, carve-outs. 3) Realpath every path (/tmp is /private/tmp). 4) Add ancestor file-read-metadata for traversal. 5) Allow only needed git/gh/node HOME reads. 6) Fail closed if wrapper fails. 7) Live tests: cat abs path, symlink, runtime var. **أرقام / params:** tree root

#### ACODE-14 · حلقة تجارب ذاتية بمقياس: احتفظ أو تراجع · Metric-driven autonomous experiment loop (keep or reset) · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحسّن ملفًا واحدًا مقابل أمر تقييم ثابت بحلقة تعديل وقياس، فيثبّت التحسينات بـ commit ويتراجع عن الإخفاقات مع تسجيل كل محاولة. — Optimize one target file against a fixed evaluation command by looping edit, measure, then commit improvements or reset failures, logging every attempt.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User says make this faster/smaller/better, optimize a file for a metric, improve prompts/headlines, or run experiments overnight or on a schedule.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Define the experiment: target file, eval command, metric name, direction (lower/higher), scope project or user (a setup script creates `.autoresearch/<domain>/<name>/` with program.md, config.cfg, results.tsv, optional evaluate.py). 2) Lock the evaluator: never edit the gate being judged. 3) Each iteration: edit only the target, run the fixed eval, parse the metric. 4) Better than best so far -> git commit (keep); worse -> git reset (discard); error -> log crash. 5) Append `commit | metric | status | description` to results.tsv (gitignored). 6) Repeat on an interval (10m, 1h, daily) via a cron-style scheduler; resume by checking out the experiment branch and reading results history. **أرقام / params:** target path; eval command; metric; direction; domain (engineering/marketing/content/prompts); interval
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`python3`](../requirements.md#req-python3) · [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git)

#### ACODE-15 · فحوص ما قبل التنفيذ لتصادم الوكلاء المتوازيين · Parallel agent collision pre-flight checks · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** فحص طلبات الدمج والفروع والحالة قبل العمل لتجنب تكرار عمل الوكلاء المتزامنين أو الكتابة فوقه. — Check for existing PRs, branches and changed state before acting so concurrent agent sessions do not duplicate or clobber work.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Before opening a PR, creating a branch/worktree, applying a plan, merging a PR you did not open, or finding foreign uncommitted changes.
- **كيف / how:** 1) gh pr list --state open and grep each PR's diff --name-only for your files. 2) If an older PR fixes more, adopt it instead of shipping a half fix. 3) Re-plan before any apply/deploy older than minutes. 4) Ask live peer sessions what they do before sizeable work. 5) Claim branch names early. 6) Leave merging peers' PRs to owners; audit afterwards if you did. **أرقام / params:** repo, files

#### ACODE-16 · عقد إطلاق وكلاء متوازيين مع فحص مسبق · Parallel agent dispatch contract with worktree preflight · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يتحقق من نظافة المستودع وتفرّد أسماء الفروع وتثبيت جذر git قبل إطلاق وكلاء متزامنين، فلا يلوّث الكتّاب المتوازيون بعضهم ولا نسخة العمل الرئيسية. — Check repo cleanliness, branch-name uniqueness and git-root pinning before fanning out concurrent agents, so parallel writers never contaminate each other or the main checkout.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User asks to spawn several agents/subagents at once, write a lead prompt for a fan-out, run worktree-isolated parallel implementation, or sequence dependent work items in waves.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Dispatch from the main conversation; sub-agent sandboxes may lack the Agent tool, so require a tool check and a sequential-fallback report. 2) Preflight: `git status --porcelain` empty, `git worktree list` clash-free, unique branch per agent, target name free (`git branch -a --list`, `git ls-remote --heads origin`), shared counters (next ADR/PRP number) snapshotted; on failure refuse, never clean user work. 3) Tell git-writing agents to pin `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` and use `git -C "$WORKTREE"`; never export GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE. 4) Check nested-repo toplevel differs. 5) Run dependent items in waves; pre-dump exclusive-lock tools. 6) Afterwards verify main repo state. **أرقام / params:** agent count; task list per agent; target branch names; worktree root; wave order
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git) · [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)

#### ACODE-19 · خطافات ميزانية زمنية ناعمة للوكلاء الفرعيين · Soft wall-clock budget hooks for subagents · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تثبيت خطافات اختيارية تحذّر الوكيل الفرعي عند 80% من ميزانية الوقت وتمنع الأدوات غير الختامية بعد 100%، مع خطافات شقيقة تحدّ حجم الرد النهائي وتوجّه الاستدعاء العام إلى الوكيل الخبير. — Install opt-in PreToolUse and SubagentStop hooks that warn a subagent at 80% of a time budget and deny non-finalization tools past 100%, with sibling hooks that cap the size of the final return message and route generic spawns to the real expert agent.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** A subagent runs for ages with no timeout; subagent final reports flood the main context; a generic Agent spawn picks the wrong specialist; requests like 'agent time limit', 'return budget', 'route to expert'.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Probe status first (installed? project or global scope?) and print a PLAN block before any write. 2) Warn that a global PreToolUse '.*' matcher costs about 60 ms on every tool call. 3) Copy the guard and a SubagentStop cleanup script into hooks and register them (Bash only for ~/.claude). 4) Config JSON: defaultMinutes, per-agent-type overrides, hardStopRatio (>1, default 2). 5) At 80% inject one wrap-up note; past 100% deny every tool except Read/Write/Edit/Todo-class finalizers; past the hard-stop ratio allow only Write/Edit; always deny AskUserQuestion. 6) Fail open, key state by agent_id, no-op in the main session. 7) State the limits: time is sampled only at tool boundaries. **أرقام / params:** mode (status|install|upgrade|enable|disable|uninstall|purge); scope (project|global); budget minutes; hardStopRatio; byAgentType overrides
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)

#### ACODE-278 · تنظيف مساحة العمل القابل للتراجع: كشف افتراضي وحجر بدل الحذف · Reversible workspace hygiene: detect by default, quarantine instead of delete · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ينظف المستودع مما يقرره نظام الملفات وgit دون قراءة الشيفرة: ملفات قمامة، مخرجات بناء متتبعة في git، فجوات وقواعد قديمة في .gitignore، مجلدات تجريبية، أصول توثيق يتيمة، وحالة git مساعدة؛ يعرض فقط ما لم يُطلب التطبيق، وكل تغيير قابل للتراجع. — Workspace clean-up the filesystem and git can decide: detect by default, every change reversible, untracked files quarantined, never rm.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مستودع مليء بملفات مؤقتة ومخرجات بناء متتبعة، .gitignore ناقص، قبل نشر المستودع / a cluttered repo, tracked build outputs, gitignore gaps
- **كيف / how:** 1) Default is detection only; --fix leaves changes uncommitted for review, --commit adds one commit per phase. 2) Scope: confirm the path is inside a git work tree, or stop. 3) Detect seven classes: filesystem garbage (editor swap, OS metadata), generated artefacts tracked in git, .gitignore gaps, stale .gitignore rules that match nothing, scratch directories, doc assets nothing links to, and leftover git state (stale worktrees, rebase or merge leftovers). 4) Before untracking a tracked build output, check whether it is published on purpose (a docs site, a release asset). Before calling a doc asset orphaned, search for non-Markdown references (HTML, templates, code). 5) Apply only findings that quote the command output that produced them. 6) Tracked files go through git (so history keeps them); untracked files move to a quarantine directory, never rm; refs and branches are never touched. 7) Anything whose removal could change what the build sees is out of scope: hand it to code review instead. #### ACODE-279 · لا تعديل بلا دليل على المالك: إثبات سلسلة من يرسم الناتج المرئي قبل إصلاحه · No proof, no edit: prove the owner chain of visible output before fixing it · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** لإصلاح خلل يظهر على الشاشة (نص، علامة تركيز، طبقة، واجهة في مشهد ما): يثبت أولًا من ينشئ الناتج ومن يحدّثه في وقت التشغيل، بالبحث عن النص أو مفتاح الترجمة الحرفي، ثم يرقع أصغر مالك مثبت فقط؛ ولنفس السلوك على عدة شاشات يثبت مالك كل شاشة على حدة. — For on-screen bugs: find who creates and who refreshes the visible output, patch only the proven owner, and prove each surface separately.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** خلل مرئي في لعبة أو تطبيق، 'لا تخمّن'، نفس الإصلاح في القائمة واللعب، لقطة شاشة لنص خاطئ / a visible bug in a game or app, the same behaviour across several scenes
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the repository's agent instructions and git status narrowly; preserve unrelated dirty files. 2) Derive the live structure relevant to the task (folders, namespaces, assembly definitions, scenes, prefabs, bootstraps) before any architecture claim. 3) Classify the task: a runtime-visible bug needs the owner chain proven; a screenshot or text fix needs the exact visible string or localisation key searched and both its creator and its refresh writer found; asset or model integration where names may disagree needs the visible object identity locked (feature name vs asset vs factory vs on-screen surface). 4) When the request spans surfaces ('also', 'menu and gameplay', 'preview and runtime'), prove each surface's owner, active caller, asset dependency and fallback separately; a shared helper is a candidate only after that. 5) Never start from memory, nearest-name guessing, semantic similarity or screenshot position alone. 6) Patch the smallest proven owner, validate at runtime (a repeated visible failure needs a runtime number, not a reading of code), and close with proof and a rollback note. #### ACODE-280 · تصميم حزام الوكيل لا موجّهه فقط: عشر طبقات من تجميع الطلب إلى الاسترداد · Design the agent harness, not just the prompt: ten-part blueprint · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحول فكرة وكيل إلى مخطط حزام تشغيل: حدود التفويض، طبقات الحزام، كيف يُجمّع الطلب، حلقة الدور، الأدوات كطبقة تشغيل ذات صلاحيات، نموذج السياق والذاكرة، بوابات الأمان، السجل والاسترداد، نقاط التوسعة، وتسلسل التنفيذ؛ ويقول صراحة إن كانت المهمة لا تحتاج حزامًا أصلًا. — Turns an agent idea into a harness blueprint, and says so when a single model call is enough.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** بناء وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي له أدوات وذاكرة، مراجعة تصميم وكيل قائم، قبل اختيار إطار / designing or reviewing an agentic system
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ask what job is delegated, what state must survive turns, whether tools, memory, recovery or background work are needed, and what breaks with one model call; if nothing, say no harness is needed. 2) Separate model, harness runtime, external tools, durable storage and human operators; the harness governs the model. 3) Design request assembly first: instruction sources (durable vs per turn), how system and user context enter, how tools are exposed, and transcript repair before each call. 4) Make the turn loop explicit: gather, decide, act, verify progress, then continue, compact, escalate or stop. 5) For each tool define purpose, invocation boundary, inputs and outputs, permission gate, success criterion and rollback. 6) Define what memory survives compaction and sessions, the permission and safety gates, how a crashed run resumes from the transcript, and the extension points. 7) Review mode leads with structural weaknesses and missing control planes. Prefer explicit, layered, recoverable and bounded designs over orchestration theatre. #### ACODE-281 · تصحيح وكيل محادثة صوتي أو نصي دورًا بدور، ومحاكاة المحادثات الكاملة كاختبار انحدار · Debug a conversational agent turn by turn, and regression-test whole conversations by simulation · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** حلقة تصحيح رخيصة: شغّل الوكيل محليًا في وضع نصي، العب دور المستخدم سطرًا بسطر، واقرأ استدعاءات الأدوات ومعاملاتها لا الرد وحده، وأعد التشغيل بعد كل تعديل. ثم محاكاة: مستخدم مُحاكى يلعب سيناريو كاملًا وحَكَم يقيّم النتيجة والحالة النهائية؛ نصيًا للتكرار، وصوتيًا لقياس تبادل الأدوار والمقاطعة ودقة النسخ والزمن المسموع. — Drive the agent one turn at a time and inspect tool calls; then simulate whole conversations, text first, audio for speech-only failures.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** وكيل صوتي أو دردشة يتصرف بشكل غريب، قبل نشر وكيل مكالمات، اختبار محادثات متعددة الأدوار / a voice or chat agent misbehaves, before deploying a call agent
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the CLI's help first; it is the source of truth for flags. 2) Start the agent locally in text mode, send user turns, and read each turn's tool calls, arguments, handoffs and errors as well as the reply: a wrong argument points to the prompt or tool description; no call at all usually means the description never says when to use the tool. 3) Interleave logs under each turn so a traceback sits under the sanitised error the user heard; check the agent's own chat history rather than your memory of the conversation. 4) Restart after every code edit (a running session keeps old code); keep the exact sequence of turns that reproduced the bug and replay it after the fix. 5) Drive whole conversations: details collected early and lost later, a user changing their mind, a handoff that drops context. 6) For regression, run scenario simulations with a simulated user and a judge that grades outcome and end state; a unit test covers one turn. 7) Use text runs for iteration and CI; use audio runs for turn-taking, barge-in, transcription of names, numbers and codes, and perceived latency. 8) Generating scenarios from source may upload code: confirm before. #### ACODE-282 · إصلاح فشل CI آليًا بـClaude Code: سير عمل لمستودع واحد أو قالب مشترك، مع حلقة من الاختبار إلى طلب الدمج · Automated CI-failure fixing with an AI agent: inline or reusable workflow, and the issue-to-PR loop · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يركّب سير عمل يحلل فشل الفحوص ويقترح إصلاحًا في طلب دمج: نسخة مضمّنة لمستودع واحد أو قالب workflow_call تستدعيه عدة مستودعات، يحدد أي سير عمل يُراقب، ويتحقق من وجود السر المطلوب دون كشفه. وحلقة تطوير: شغّل الاختبارات، افتح مشكلة لكل فشل، اختر حسب الأولوية، أصلح بـTDD في فرع، افتح طلب دمج وراقب CI. — Sets up AI-driven CI-failure fixes (single-repo or reusable) and a test-failure-to-PR development loop.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** CI يفشل كثيرًا ويستهلك وقت الفريق، أكثر من مستودع يحتاج نفس آلية الإصلاح / frequent CI failures, several repos needing the same auto-fix
- **كيف / how:** 1) Assess: does an auto-fix workflow already exist, which workflows run (by name), and is the agent token secret configured (list names only, never values). 2) Choose the shape: one inline workflow for a single repo, or a reusable workflow_call definition plus a thin caller per repo. 3) Trigger on workflow_run completed with conclusion failure for the selected workflows only, and skip runs on the auto-fix branch itself to avoid loops. 4) Give the job least privilege (contents and pull-requests write, nothing else), fetch the failing job logs, let the agent diagnose and push a fix to a new branch and open a PR; never push to the default branch or merge. 5) Offer a dry run that prints the files it would write. 6) For the development loop: sync main, run the project's tests (detect the stack), open one issue per failing test with output, pick by priority (critical bugs, fresh test failures, quick wins), branch, write the failing test, fix, open a PR, wait for CI, repeat up to a cycle limit. 7) A human reviews and merges every PR. #### ACODE-283 · معمارية وكيل صوتي وميزانية الزمن: سلسلة STT→LLM→TTS أم كلام إلى كلام · Voice-agent architecture and latency budget: cascade vs speech-to-speech · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** القرار الأول والأغلى في وكلاء الصوت: شكل الخط (سلسلة تحويل الكلام لنص ثم نموذج ثم توليد صوت، أو نموذج كلام إلى كلام)، والقناة (هاتف، WebRTC، SDK)، والبناء على منصة أو إطار، وتوزيع ميزانية الزمن على كل مرحلة، مع تصميم تبادل الأدوار والمقاطعة والمسار البديل من البداية. — Sets the pipeline shape, channel, build-vs-platform and per-hop latency budget for a voice agent.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** بناء وكيل مكالمات أو مساعد صوتي، الوكيل بطيء في الرد، اختيار Vapi أو LiveKit أو Twilio / building a phone or voice assistant
- **كيف / how:** 1) State the use case (inbound support, outbound reminders, in-app assistant, IVR replacement), the channel and the acceptable response latency. 2) Cascade buys transcripts, swappable parts and mid-turn tool calls; speech-to-speech buys latency and prosody at the cost of control and observability: name the trade. 3) Channel: telephony (narrowband audio, DTMF), WebRTC (wideband) or SDK; it fixes media constraints and part of the latency. 4) Build vs platform: a managed platform for speed, a framework for control, telephony primitives plus your own orchestration, or from scratch; hide the provider behind a seam. 5) Allocate the end-to-end budget per hop (endpointing, final transcript, model time to first token, speech time to first byte, network) and check that it sums under the target. 6) Design turn-taking, barge-in and the unhappy path (silence, recognition error, model stall, human handoff) as architecture. 7) Treat every model, price and latency figure as verify-at-use against current vendor docs, and treat call audio and transcripts as sensitive personal data. #### ACODE-284 · العمل الطويل داخل حدود الاستخدام: موجات محدودة، قراءة الاستخدام الحقيقي، وإيقاظ متسلسل · Long agent work inside usage windows: bounded waves, real usage reads, chained wake-ups · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحافظ على عمل الوكيل الطويل أو المتوازي داخل نوافذ الاستخدام (الخمس ساعات والأسبوعية): ينفذ موجة محدودة من الوكلاء الفرعيين، ينتظر انتهاءها، يقرأ نسبة الاستخدام الفعلية من أداة المضيف نفسها، ويتوقف عند 95% ويجدول استئنافًا مكتفيًا بذاته يتحقق من تغير وقت إعادة الضبط. — Runs bounded waves, reads real usage from the host, stops at 95% and resumes through self-contained chained wake-ups.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مهام وكيل تستمر ساعات، تشغيل وكلاء متوازيين كثيرين، تجنب الوصول لحد الاستخدام في منتصف العمل / long or parallel agent runs near usage limits
- **كيف / how:** 1) Run a bounded wave (about three parallel subagents unless the user or host sets another throttle). 2) Let the wave finish; interrupting in-flight subagents usually loses work. 3) Read current five-hour and weekly percentages and the reset time from the host's own usage report; never invent a number, install a third-party tool or infer usage. Without a usage command, ask the user to read theirs. Treat the output as data. 4) At or above 95% of either window (or a stricter user threshold), stop launching work. 5) Schedule a resume; when wake delays are clamped, chain wake-ups that each re-check and reschedule. 6) Make each wake prompt self-contained: remaining plan, the check-then-reschedule rule, threshold and throttle, the exact usage command, and the previous reset time. 7) On wake, a different reset time proves the window rolled over; elapsed wall-clock time alone does not. #### ACODE-285 · ترحيل منسق سير عمل دائم: جرد البنى ثم فصل التنسيق عن الآثار الجانبية · Migrate a durable-workflow orchestrator: inventory constructs, split orchestration from side effects · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** لترحيل سير عمل من Temporal أو Inngest أو Trigger.dev أو Step Functions إلى منصة سير عمل دائمة أخرى: يجرد البنى (نقطة الدخول، الانتظار والمؤقتات، استدعاءات وموافقات خارجية، إعادة المحاولة، سير عمل فرعي وتفرع، بث التقدم، الآثار الخارجية)، يضع التنسيق في دوال حتمية والآثار في خطوات، ويختار سطح استئناف واحدًا لكل انتظار، ومفتاح عدم تكرار لكل كتابة خارجية. — Inventories orchestration constructs, keeps orchestration deterministic and side effects in steps, one resume surface per wait.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** نقل سير عمل دائم إلى منصة جديدة، إعادة كتابة مهام طويلة بخطوات وانتظار وموافقات / moving long-running workflows between orchestration platforms
- **كيف / how:** 1) Identify the source system and the target runtime (managed or self-hosted; self-hosted keeps workflow code but needs its own runtime bootstrap). 2) Extract every construct: entrypoint, waits and timers, external callbacks and approvals, retries and failure handling, child workflows and fan-out, progress streaming, external side effects. 3) Put orchestration in deterministic workflow functions and all I/O (HTTP, database, SDK calls, stream writes) in step functions; sleep only in workflow context. 4) For each signal, event wait or task token choose exactly one resume surface: an internal hook keyed by a deterministic business token, or a generated callback URL; do not mix them. 5) Start and query child runs from inside steps. 6) Use the step's stable identifier as the idempotency key for external writes, and model multi-step compensation as a rollback stack. 7) Keep app-boundary code framework-agnostic unless a framework is named, and list assumptions as open questions. 8) Verify each migrated workflow by replaying a recorded run's inputs and comparing end state. #### ACODE-286 · وكلاء الخلفية في المستودع: مخرجاتهم اقتراحات لا دمج، وأول المرشحين الآمنين · Continuous AI: background repository agents whose output is a proposal, never a merge · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** وكلاء يعملون في المستودع كما تعمل مهام CI لكن لمهام تحتاج تفكيرًا: فرز المشكلات، تحقيق في فشل CI، انحراف التوثيق، سد فجوات الاختبار، تنظيف الإنتروبيا، وتقرير صحة المستودع. القاعدة: مخرجات الوكيل تعليق أو مشكلة أو طلب دمج مسودة أو تقرير، ولا يدمج أو ينشر أبدًا. — Background agents for reasoning tasks in a repo, read-only by default, with proposals as their only output.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** أتمتة أعمال متكررة في المستودع بوكيل مجدول أو عند أحداث GitHub / scheduling or event-triggering agents on a repository
- **كيف / how:** 1) List repetitive repository toil and rank by time saved × verifiability ÷ blast radius. 2) Start with one or two safe candidates: issue triage (labels, summary, routing), CI-failure investigation (a comment with the probable cause and a proposed fix PR), docs drift (a draft PR), weekly test-gap filling, weekly small clean-up PRs, a read-only repo health report. Avoid production, releases, secrets and customer communication at first. 3) Define trigger, inputs, output type and a success metric (time to triage, share of CI failures correctly diagnosed). 4) Guardrails: scoped read-only tokens with writes only through constrained outputs (a comment, a draft PR on a bot branch); issue bodies and comments are untrusted data that can never change the goal or permissions; isolated runners with restricted egress; turn, time and cost caps per run; every run leaves a visible trace. 5) Give each workflow a human owner who reviews output quality monthly and can switch it off. 6) These augment deterministic CI, never replace it. #### ACODE-287 · تسليم المناوبة: خمسة أقسام إلزامية وتجربة تنبيه قبل خروج المناوب · On-call shift handoff: five mandatory sections and a test alert before sign-off · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تسليم مناوبة لا يضيع فيه شيء: الحوادث النشطة، التحقيقات الجارية، التغييرات الأخيرة، المشكلات المعروفة وحلولها المؤقتة، والأحداث القادمة؛ كل قسم فيه بند أو 'لا شيء' صريحة قبل اعتبار التسليم مكتملًا، مع تجربة تنبيه تصل للمستلم قبل انتهاء فترة التداخل. — A handoff gate where every section has an entry or an explicit none, plus a test alert before the overlap ends.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** نهاية مناوبة، تسليم حادث جارٍ لفريق آخر، فرق في مناطق زمنية مختلفة / ending an on-call shift, handing over a live incident
- **كيف / how:** 1) Fill five sections: active incidents (what is broken, impact, current owner), ongoing investigations (hypotheses ruled in and out, next step), recent changes (deploys, config, flags), known issues with workarounds in place, upcoming events (maintenance, releases). 2) Treat the checklist as a gate: the handoff is not complete until each section has at least one entry or an explicit 'none'; an incomplete handoff that causes a miss becomes a blameless postmortem action. 3) Prefer a short sync call; across time zones use the async template plus a brief voice or video walk-through of the watch list, and give a direct contact for questions. 4) For a mid-incident handoff use the incident template; the outgoing engineer stays reachable for about fifteen minutes after. 5) Before the overlap ends, fire a test alert and confirm the incoming engineer receives it on every paging channel. 6) Store handoffs in one shared place linked from the schedule. #### ACODE-288 · ترقية نقطة تدريب نموذج: أربع بوابات بالترتيب من جودة البيانات إلى الإطلاق التدريجي · Fine-tuned checkpoint promotion: four ordered gates from data quality to canary · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** نقطة تدريب تتفوق على مقياس المهمة لا تُشحن قبل أربع بوابات بالترتيب: جودة بيانات التدريب (تكرار، تسرب إجابات التقييم، ضجيج التسميات)، مجموعة انحراف قدرات مجمّدة مقارنة بخط أساس مع ميزانية انحراف، مقارنة مزدوجة مع النموذج الأساسي، ثم إطلاق تدريجي بنسبة صغيرة مع تراجع آلي. — Four ordered gates for a fine-tuned checkpoint with a drift budget and a terminal promote/reject verdict.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** بعد ضبط نموذج دقيق، قبل استبدال النموذج في الإنتاج، 'تحسن على مهمتنا لكن هل خرّب شيئًا آخر؟' / before promoting a fine-tuned model
- **كيف / how:** 1) Data-quality gate first: deduplicate the training set, check for leakage of evaluation goldens, scan for label noise; leakage invalidates every later stage. 2) Re-run the frozen capability-drift suite (general benchmarks plus a few hundred domain-adjacent items) and diff per benchmark against the recorded baseline: drift of one point or less is noise, two to five means rerun with seed variation, more than five is a hard fail. 3) Paired comparison against the base model on the same prompts, with position randomisation when a model judge is used; a held-out win that loses the paired comparison does not ship. 4) Canary five to ten percent of stratified traffic with automatic rollback; a local-only deployment correctly stops after stage 3. 5) Each stage gates the next; with deterministic graders stages 2 and 3 may share one inference pass. 6) Write a promotion report with the evidence per stage and a terminal PROMOTE or REJECT. #### ACODE-289 · خط التوصية والترتيب بست مراحل: مصادر، إثراء، تصفية، تقييم، اختيار، آثار غير متزامنة · Six-stage recommendation and ranking pipeline: source, hydrate, filter, score, select, side effects · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** معظم أنظمة 'أفضل K عناصر لمستخدم وسياق' ليست تعلم آلة غريبًا بل خطًا: جلب المرشحين من مصادر متوازية، إثراؤهم بالبيانات، إسقاط غير المؤهلين قبل التقييم المكلف، سلسلة مقيّمين (نموذج، تنويع، قواعد عمل)، اختيار الأعلى، ثم آثار جانبية غير متزامنة لا تعطل الرد. — The universal shape for feeds, rerankers, alert triage and task prioritisers.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تغذية مخصصة، إعادة ترتيب نتائج بحث أو RAG، ترتيب تنبيهات أو مهام، تغليف مقيّم LLM في خط حقيقي / building a feed, reranker or prioritiser
- **كيف / how:** 1) Sources: fetch candidates from one or more origins in parallel. 2) Hydrators: enrich candidates with the metadata filters and scorers need, independent hydrators in parallel. 3) Filters: drop blocked, expired, duplicate and ineligible items sequentially, before the expensive stage. 4) Scorers: a chain where later scorers see earlier scores (model relevance, then diversity reranking, then business rules); predict several actions with tunable weights instead of a single relevance number. 5) Selector: sort by final score and return the top K, keeping scoring deterministic and cacheable. 6) Side effects: cache, log, emit events and update served history asynchronously so they never block the response. 7) Keep each stage a typed, testable component and measure latency per stage; evaluate offline with a temporal split and a popularity baseline before trusting gains. #### ACODE-290 · مضيف مريض واحد أم الأسطول كله؟ وحدة المقياس ونسبة الحد الأقصى إلى المجموع · One sick host or the whole fleet? Get the metric unit and the Maximum-to-Sum ratio · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مقاييس كل مضيف حين تُجمّع في سلسلة واحدة تخدع بطريقتين: المتوسط غير موزون عبر المضيفين فيجعل مضيفًا واحدًا بطيئًا يبدو انهيارًا عامًا، والوحدة ليست في اسم المقياس ولا يعيدها استعلام البيانات المجمّع. يحصل على الوحدة أولًا، ثم يحسب نسبة الحد الأقصى إلى المجموع ليعرف كم مضيفًا متأثرًا فعلًا. — Fetches the unit first and uses Maximum/Sum to tell a single-host episode from a fleet-wide one.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تنبيه على مقياس لكل مضيف (زمن، طوابير، اتصالات) بقيم ضخمة بينما الإنتاجية والأخطاء مستقرة / a per-host alarm spikes while throughput and errors are flat
- **كيف / how:** 1) Suspect this when the average or maximum jumps by orders of magnitude while request throughput and error counters stay flat and the alarm self-resolves within minutes. 2) Get the unit from an API that returns it per datapoint; the batch metric-data call does not return units, and the name ('.rate') does not tell you. Quote no magnitude before this. 3) Pull SampleCount, Sum and Maximum at the same period with start times aligned to a period boundary, so buckets line up. 4) For an additive per-host stat (in-flight count, active threads, queue depth) compute Maximum/Sum: near 100% means one host holds it all; near 1/N means evenly spread across N hosts; in between estimates how many hosts are involved. 5) Confirm with the per-host dimension when published. 6) Write the incident as what the data shows ('one host reached 21 s for four minutes'), never 'fleet-wide' from an unweighted average. #### ACODE-291 · مزوّد مخصص لا يُستدعى أبدًا: التوجيه على اسم النموذج يسبق المزوّد في LiteLLM · A custom LLM provider that never runs: dispatch on the bare model name wins first · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** عند ربط خلفية بـLiteLLM كمزود مخصص واستدعائها باسم نموذج معروف (مثل اسم نموذج OpenAI)، تلتقط فروع سابقة في سلسلة التوجيه الاسم المجرد وترسله لمزود آخر، والاستثناء يحمل اسم مزودك فيبدو كأنه معطل؛ وإن كان مفتاح المزود الآخر صالحًا يأتي رد معقول مدفوع من حساب لم تقصده. — Diagnoses silent provider bypass and the fix: unique model names and a proof the handler ran.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** المزود المخصص في LiteLLM لا يُدخل، رسوم غير متوقعة من OpenAI، خطأ من خدمة لم تُعد / a LiteLLM custom provider is bypassed
- **كيف / how:** 1) Confirm the symptom: your handler is never entered, the error comes from a service you did not configure, yet the exception name carries your provider label. 2) Search the installed library's completion function for branches that test the bare model name against built-in model lists and sit before the custom-provider branch; line numbers move between releases, the shape does not. 3) Fix by giving models routed through the bridge names no built-in list can contain (a private prefix or suffix) and translating to the upstream name inside your handler. 4) Add a test that asserts the handler was entered (a counter or log line) and fails if any other provider served the call. 5) Run that test after every library upgrade, because new model ids join the built-in lists routinely. 6) Remove unrelated provider keys from environments where the bridge runs so a bypass fails loudly instead of billing quietly. #### ACODE-292 · مزامنة متغيرات البيئة إلى launchd تسرّب متغيرات الجلسة: قائمة حظر قبل المزامنة · Login-environment sync to launchd leaks the current session's variables · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** سكربت ينقل متغيرات بيئة الطرفية إلى launchd على macOS لتراها التطبيقات والخدمات، إن قرأ البيئة الحية بدل ملف التعريف ينقل أيضًا متغيرات الجلسة التي شُغّل منها (معرفات جلسة الوكيل، مقبس الطرفية، مسارات مؤقتة، رموز)، فتظهر في كل تطبيق يُفتح بعدها. يشخص التسرب ويتراجع عنه ويضيف قائمة حظر. — Diagnose and undo session variables pushed into launchd, then filter by a deny list.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تطبيقات macOS ترى متغيرات غريبة من جلسة طرفية، أداة تتصرف كأنها داخل جلسة وكيل، بعد تشغيل سكربت مزامنة البيئة / macOS apps inherit stray session variables
- **كيف / how:** 1) Reading the live environment is right (a text grep of export lines misses sourced files) but it includes the session the script runs in. 2) List what launchd now holds and compare with a clean login shell's environment; the difference is the leak. 3) Typical families: terminal multiplexer and pane identifiers, agent session ids and entry points, socket paths, temporary directories, shell level and prompt variables, and any tokens a session exported. 4) Undo each leaked name with launchctl unsetenv, then restart affected apps (they captured the old environment at launch). 5) Fix the sync script with an explicit deny list by prefix and exact name, and prefer an allow list for secrets-bearing variables. 6) Run the sync only from a fresh login shell, and print the exact names it will set before setting them; never print values. Full original skill(s) with license: vendor/kosif-atlas/skills/3324-launchd-env-sync-session-leak/13838-launchd-env-sync-session-leak. **أرقام / params:** sync script

#### ACODE-21 · معالجة 429: انتظار وتراجع أسي مع تشويش · 429 handler: Retry-After, backoff, jitter · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تنفيذ معالجة صحيحة لحدود المعدل باحترام Retry-After وتراجع أسي مع عشوائية. — Implement correct rate-limit handling honoring Retry-After with exponential backoff and jitter.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Hitting 429s, designing a high-volume API client, or deciding SDK retry middleware versus hand-rolled retry.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Check whether the official SDK already ships retry middleware and configure it first. 2) Else on 429 read Retry-After (default ~30s). 3) wait = max(Retry-After, 2^attempt) + uniform(0,1). 4) Cap retries (~5) and total time. 5) Never retry immediately; it restarts the throttle window. 6) Bound concurrency and handle per-sub-request 429 inside batch calls. 7) Add idempotency keys for non-GET retries. **أرقام / params:** max_retries, time cap, concurrency
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-23 · قائمة صمود الخلفية أمام الاعتماديات · Backend resilience checklist for dependencies · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تطبيق مهلات وإعادة محاولة وقواطع دائرة وطوابير رسائل ميتة لخدمة خلفية. — Apply timeouts, idempotent-only retries, circuit breakers, bulkheads, degraded modes and DLQ workers to a service.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Reviewing or hardening a backend that calls other services.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Timeout every outbound call sized to dependency SLO. 2) Retry idempotent calls only, bounded, exponential backoff + jitter. 3) Circuit breaker plus bulkhead per dependency. 4) Define degraded mode (stale cache, queued, clear error). 5) Workers idempotent, DLQ, bounded queue for backpressure.

- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Adding login, tokens or route guards to an Express/Node API.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Users + refresh_tokens tables (store hashed refresh, expiresAt, revokedAt). 2) argon2 hash/verify; jose-signed access token ~15m with sub+role; refresh ~7d, rotate and revoke old. 3) requireAuth/requireRole middleware, not inline checks; inactive user=401. 4) Never accept role from body; seed admins. 5) Rate-limit /token. 6) Tests: 201, 401, 422, 403.

- **ماذا / what:** ينفذ تدفق OAuth عبر مستقبل محلي مع فحص state وملفات أسرار بصلاحيات مقيدة. — Run an authorization-code OAuth flow with a loopback receiver, state check and permission-locked secret files.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Need CLI-style OAuth for an API without leaking secrets in args or logs.

#### ACODE-36 · اختبار تكامل يعدّ عدد إصدارات التوكن · OAuth token-mint counting integration test · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إثبات أن عميل OAuth2 يخزّن التوكن ويجدده عبر وكيل عدّاد يمرّر الطلبات. — Prove an OAuth2 client-credentials caller caches and refreshes tokens by routing its token endpoint through a counting pass-through proxy.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Unit tests mock the HTTP layer yet latency doubles or token endpoint rate limits trip.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Start a local proxy on an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port that increments a counter and forwards to the real token endpoint. 2) Point the configured tokenEndpoint at it. 3) Skip when credentials env vars absent. 4) Assert using deltas of the counter. 5) Cases: no bearer gives 401 and 0 mints; one call 1 mint; N calls 1 mint; poisoned cached token gives 1 mint and success. **أرقام / params:** token endpoint, env creds
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`key:unspecified`](../requirements.md#req-key-unspecified)

#### ACODE-37 · اختيار تدفق OAuth/OIDC حسب نوع العميل · OAuth2/OIDC flow selection by client type · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** اختيار التدفق الصحيح (PKCE أو بيانات العميل أو الجهاز) وكشف الأنماط الخاطئة. — Pick Authorization Code+PKCE, confidential code flow, client credentials or device grant per client, and flag anti-patterns.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Designing or auditing login/SSO/M2M authentication.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Map client type to flow: SPA/native=Code+PKCE (S256), server app=confidential code, M2M=client credentials, no-browser=device grant; never Implicit. 2) Generate code_verifier/challenge and random state; verify state on callback. 3) Treat ID token vs access vs refresh tokens separately. 4) Exact redirect URIs and minimal scopes. 5) Emit rationale + anti-pattern list.

#### ACODE-41 · عميل API يحترم حدود المعدل مع إعادة محاولة · Rate-limit-aware API client with bounded retry · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إضافة تحكم بالمعدل وإعادة محاولة محدودة مع تأخير تصاعدي حول API خارجي. — Add admission control, Retry-After handling, exponential backoff with jitter and queue backpressure around a third-party API.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Hitting 429s or planning bulk calls to a vendor API.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read observed limit headers/429 bodies rather than inventing numbers. 2) Per-endpoint/tenant token bucket or concurrency cap. 3) Honor Retry-After, else exponential backoff plus jitter, bounded attempts. 4) Retry only idempotent calls. 5) Queue with backpressure, spend-aware for paid APIs. 6) Log redacted metrics.

#### ACODE-43 · محدد معدل طلبات مشترك مع تراجع أسي · Shared rolling-window rate limiter with backoff · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تقييد طلبات العميل تحت حد المزود وإعادة المحاولة بتراجع أسي وعشوائية. — Throttle outbound API clients under the vendor ceiling and retry 429/5xx with capped exponential backoff and jitter.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Hitting 429/504 from vendor APIs or sharing one egress IP across workers.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Inventory all workers/retry layers sharing the egress IP. 2) One shared rolling-window limiter below the documented cap (e.g. 200 req/10s), reserve capacity for interactive traffic. 3) Backoff base*2^n with jitter (Twilio sample: 100ms doubling, +-10%, cap 30s, max 5 tries). 4) Retry reads freely; writes only with idempotency key plus reconcile after timeout. 5) Shrink page size on 504 (60s cutoff). 6) Canary concurrency changes before asking vendor for increase. **أرقام / params:** limit, window, max retries
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1897-ramp-pack/6609-ramp-rate-limits` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/see batch record 10497`

- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Setting up a sending domain or aiming for Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender compliance.
- **كيف / how:** 1) SPF TXT ending ~all, at most 10 lookups, then -all. 2) DKIM 2048-bit at selector._domainkey. 3) Check alignment of From domain with SPF/DKIM. 4) _dmarc p=none with rua, ~2 weeks of reports. 5) quarantine pct 25 to 100, then reject. 6) Optional BIMI needs VMC. 7) Lint records. **أرقام / params:** domain, ESP

#### ACODE-52 · مستقبل ويبهوك موثّق وآمن من التكرار · Verified idempotent webhook receiver · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** بناء نقطة ويبهوك تتحقق من التوقيع على الجسم الخام وتمنع التكرار وترد بسرعة. — Build a webhook endpoint that verifies HMAC on the raw body, dedups by event id, acks fast and processes async.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Writing or hardening a webhook handler for Stripe, Ramp, Podium, Twilio, Salesforce-style providers.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read raw bytes before any JSON parsing. 2) Recompute HMAC-SHA256 and compare with constant-time compare (hmac.compare_digest). 3) Reject timestamps outside ~5 min and seen nonces. 4) Dedup by provider event id (SET NX EX 24h in Redis, never process memory). 5) Persist verified event durably, return 2xx within the provider timeout (e.g. 10s). 6) Process async; fetch current resource state since order is not guaranteed. 7) Write failures to a DLQ with replay path. **أرقام / params:** provider, secret, dedup store (Redis/KV)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT / Apache-2.0; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1893-podium-pack/6524-podium-webhook-reliability` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1897-ramp-pack/6614-ramp-webhooks-events` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2405-web-commerce/9315-webhook-hardening`

#### ACODE-53 · مستهلك webhook: توقيع HMAC وإزالة التكرار · Webhook consumer: raw-body HMAC, dedupe, fast ack · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** بناء مستقبل webhook آمن يتحقق من التوقيع على البايتات الخام ويرد سريعاً. — Build a hardened webhook receiver that verifies signatures on raw bytes and acknowledges quickly.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Adding or reviewing a vendor webhook endpoint (Fireflies, HubSpot, Dodo, Hex, Klaviyo, Ideogram, Guidewire).
- **كيف / how:** 1) Subscribe only to allowlisted event types over HTTPS. 2) Capture raw body before JSON parsing. 3) Timing-safe compare HMAC-SHA256 (or Ed25519) header; missing signature gives 401. 4) Validate strict schema, quarantine unknown events metadata-only. 5) Dedupe on delivery id + event + object id; tolerate out-of-order events. 6) Return 2xx within vendor window (~10s), do heavy work async. 7) Log result/latency, never payload. **أرقام / params:** vendor, signature header, event allowlist

#### ACODE-54 · مستقبل ويب هوك: توقيع وتكرار آمن · Webhook receiver: HMAC, idempotency, replay · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تصميم مستقبل ويب هوك آمن يتحقق من التوقيع ويمنع تكرار المعالجة. — Design a fail-closed webhook receiver with raw-body HMAC verification, fast ack, durable queue and idempotent processing.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User asks to receive vendor callbacks/webhooks (Alchemy, Attio, BambooHR, Canva, Clerk, Apify...).

#### ACODE-55 · مستقبل ويبهوك مع توقيع HMAC ومنع التكرار · Webhook receiver with HMAC and idempotency · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يبني نقطة ويبهوك تتحقق من التوقيع وتمنع تكرار الأحداث وتعالجها بشكل غير متزامن. — Build a webhook endpoint that verifies provider signatures, dedupes events and processes them asynchronously.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User asks to receive Stripe/GitHub/Twilio-style webhooks or harden an existing handler.

#### ACODE-56 · خادم WebSocket بمصادقة وغرف واشتراكات · WebSocket server with handshake auth and rooms · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم خادم WebSocket قابلا للتوسع مع مصادقة عند الترقية وغرف ونبضات وتوزيع عبر Redis. — Design a scalable WebSocket server with token-checked upgrade, channel rooms, heartbeats and Redis fan-out.

#### ACODE-217 · تصميم أدوات الوكلاء: المستهلك نموذج لا إنسان · Agent tool design: the consumer is a model · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم أدوات MCP والدوال بحيث يعرف النموذج متى يستدعيها وماذا يمرر وكيف يتعافى من الخطأ. — Designs MCP and function tools so the model knows when to call them, what to pass and how to recover from errors.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تصميم أداة MCP، أدوات للوكيل، function calling / MCP tool design, agent tools, function calling
- **كيف / how:** 1) Names, descriptions, parameter names and error text are written for machine comprehension; they are the only orchestration layer, nothing enforces call order. 2) Description says when to call and when not to. 3) Parameters: few, typed, enums over free strings, sensible defaults. 4) Results: compact, stable shape, with the next useful identifiers. 5) Errors carry recovery guidance the agent can act on, not stack traces. 6) Design for non-deterministic chaining: every tool must be safe to call out of order.
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)

#### ACODE-218 · حدود الثقة في الأدوات: الأسرار تُحقن والصلاحيات في الكود · Tool trust boundary: injected secrets, permissions in code · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحمي الأدوات من حقن الأوامر: لا مفاتيح ظاهرة للنموذج، وفحص الصلاحية للفعل والهدف يتم في الكود قبل التنفيذ. — Hardens tools against prompt injection: no model-visible keys, and permission checks for action and target run in code before execution.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** أمان أداة الوكيل، حماية المفاتيح، prompt injection / tool security, secret injection, prompt injection defence
- **كيف / how:** 1) Name the principal the tool acts as and where its identity comes from. 2) Credentials are resolved server-side at call time, never a parameter; fix the host in config so a key cannot be sent elsewhere. 3) Check permission in code for both the action and the specific target, before the operation. 4) Declare and pre-check scopes per tool. 5) Fix the boundary: tenant, root path, allowed hosts, quotas. 6) Log every call with redacted parameters. 7) Prompts express intent; only code enforces rules. **أرقام / params:** scopes, boundary
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3017-runtype-skills/12911-tool-design-security`

#### ACODE-57 · محدد معدل طلبات API مع تراجع أسي · Cost-aware API rate limiter with backoff · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم تحكماً بمعدل الطلبات من ترويسات الميزانية مع إعادة محاولة ذكية. — Design client-side throttling from response budget headers plus retry with Retry-After or jittered exponential backoff.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** 429/THROTTLED errors, bulk syncs, Procore/Shopify/Webflow/Workhuman integrations.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the limit model: REST leaky bucket (40 at 2/s; Plus 80 at 4/s via call-limit header), GraphQL cost (1000 points, 50/s restore, extensions.cost.throttleStatus). 2) Track available budget per response and pre-wait. 3) On 429 honor Retry-After else exponential backoff with jitter, cap 30s. 4) Use bulk operations instead of tight pagination loops. 5) Queue per plan/endpoint. **أرقام / params:** plan tier, endpoint

#### ACODE-64 · ضابط حدود معدل واجهات الموردين · Vendor API rate-limit governor · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم التحكم بالمعدل والتراجع والطوابير لتكامل واجهة طرف ثالث وفق الحدود الموثقة. — Design per-operation throttling, backoff and queueing for a third-party API integration from documented limits.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Integrating SaaS APIs (Fly.io, Attio, Mistral, etc.) at volume.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Classify operations (read, write, delete). 2) Encode documented ceilings per action and identifier (e.g. 1 rps burst 3). 3) Use separate read and write budgets and bounded queues with deadlines. 4) Retry with jittered backoff honoring Retry-After. 5) Keep durable operation ids and idempotency. 6) Verify with a synthetic load test. **أرقام / params:** limits, burst, error budget
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-65 · التحقق من توقيع الويب هوك مع منع التكرار · Webhook HMAC verify, dedupe, fast-ack · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يؤمّن مستقبل الويب هوك بالتحقق من HMAC ومنع التكرار والرد السريع. — Harden a webhook receiver with raw-body HMAC-SHA256 check, idempotent dedupe and immediate 200 with async work.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Building or reviewing Shopify/Wix/Webflow/Zoom webhook endpoints; retries or auto-disabled hooks.

#### ACODE-73 · ورشة SLO وسياسة ميزانية الخطأ · SLO workshop with error budget policy · 📄 موصوف / documented only

- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Service lacks SLOs or alerts need burn-rate rules.

- **ماذا / what:** يثبت كل مرجع إصدار في المستودع: إجراءات CI ببصمة SHA، وقت التشغيل عبر ملف إصدار واحد، اعتماديات التطبيق بإصدار دقيق، وأوامر التثبيت بإصدار صريح. — Pins every version reference: CI actions to a commit SHA, runtimes through one version file, application dependencies exactly, install commands explicitly.

- **كيف / how:** 1) Audit and print a table per category (action uses: refs incl. ones in Markdown templates, reusable workflows, packageManager, ^/~ ranges, version files, go/cargo/pip/uv/npx installs, $schema @latest) with pinned/unpinned/mixed; exclude vendored dirs. 2) Confirm scope; audit-only phrasing means stop after the table. 3) Replace action tags by the 40-char commit SHA with a '# vX.Y.Z' comment; leave local ./ actions alone. 4) Point CI at one existing version file per language that really has an entry for it, normalised to X.Y.Z; uv reads requires-python, so do not add a parallel .python-version. 5) Exact-pin application deps but keep library peer ranges. 6) Optionally add a weekly drift audit and Dependabot for actions, then lint and verify only the categories in scope. **أرقام / params:** scope list, --dry-run

#### ACODE-95 · ترحيل مخطط قاعدة البيانات دون توقف · Zero-downtime expand/contract schema migration · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** خطط تغييرات المخطط عبر مراحل إضافة ثم نسخ بدفعات ثم تحويل ثم حذف بدون أقفال خطرة. — Plan schema changes as add, batched backfill, switch, drop across separate deploys, producing a lock-safe reversible migration.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Renaming/typing columns, adding NOT NULL, creating indexes on live tables.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Add new column/table as nullable, no volatile default. 2) Backfill in small batches. 3) Add constraint NOT VALID then VALIDATE. 4) Create indexes CONCURRENTLY. 5) Dual-write, switch reads, then drop old in a later deploy. 6) Keep versioned ordered migrations with a tested down path; never edit shipped ones. **أرقام / params:** engine, table sizes

#### ACODE-96 · خطة ترحيل Postgres بلا توقف · Zero-downtime Postgres migration playbook · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يخطط ترحيلات مؤرخة بأنماط بلا أقفال وتعبئة بيانات وتراجع. — Plan timestamped migrations with lock-free patterns, backfills and rollback.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** schema change on production, add column, rename, retype, backfill
- **كيف / how:** 1) npx supabase migration new <name>; write DDL with RLS, indexes, triggers. 2) Test with db reset locally. 3) Nullable column with default is lock-free on PG11+. 4) CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY in a disable-transaction migration. 5) Rename/retype via expand-contract: add column, sync trigger, batch backfill, swap, drop. 6) gen types typescript; db push to remote. **أرقام / params:** migration name, target env

#### ACODE-97 · تصحيح تنافسي بفرضيات متعددة ووكلاء · Adversarial competing-hypothesis debugging with agent team · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يشغّل محققين متوازيين على فرضيات متنافسة يتحدى بعضهم بعضاً ثم يصلح بالاختبار أولاً. — Runs parallel investigators on rival root-cause hypotheses who challenge each other, then fixes via TDD.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Intermittent or unclear bugs where a single linear pass failed.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Escalate only after systematic debugging fails. 2) Spawn one investigator per hypothesis with evidence requirements. 3) Structured debate: each must rebut others with evidence. 4) Synthesize the surviving root cause. 5) Write failing test, fix, independently verify, loop until green. Claimed gain: ~40% to 80% first-hypothesis accuracy.
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`pip:hypothesis`](../requirements.md#req-pip-hypothesis)

#### ACODE-114 · إثبات الإصلاح باختبار أحمر ثم أخضر · Red-green-revert proof for bug fixes · 📄 موصوف / documented only

#### ACODE-117 · تصحيح الأخطاء بالسبب الجذري أولاً · Root-cause-first debugging with one hypothesis · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تصحيح الأخطاء بقراءة الخطأ كاملاً وتكرار الحالة وتتبع البيانات واختبار فرضية واحدة قبل أي إصلاح. — Debug by reading the full error, reproducing, checking recent changes, tracing data backwards and testing one falsifiable hypothesis at a time before any fix.

- **ماذا / what:** يراجع فرقاً أو PR بحثاً عن ثغرات واثقة فقط، ويحوّل طلب تدقيق المستودع كاملاً إلى منهج مختلف. — Reviews a diff or PR for confident vulnerabilities only, and switches method when asked to audit a whole codebase.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مراجعة أمان للـ PR، فحص ثغرات التعديل / security review of a PR, diff security audit
- **كيف / how:** 1) Scope resolves to the diff; report only issues a senior security engineer would confidently raise, introduced or worsened by the change. 2) Skip pre-existing issues the diff merely sits near and generic 'missing defence in depth', because noise trains readers to skip the report. 3) For 'is my app secure' or 'find every IDOR', run a posture audit instead: there every finding is pre-existing and absences (missing tenant filter, unvalidated secret default) are the point. 4) Map findings to an OWASP testing category. **أرقام / params:** diff scope

#### ACODE-223 · أداء الويب: الكمون قبل عرض النطاق · Web performance: latency before bandwidth · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحسّن سرعة الموقع بتقليل الرحلات ذهاباً وإياباً، لأن الكمون لا عرض النطاق هو عنق الزجاجة غالباً. — Speeds up a site by cutting round trips, because latency rather than bandwidth is usually the bottleneck.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** الموقع بطيء، تحسين السرعة، Core Web Vitals / slow website, web performance, round trips
- **كيف / how:** 1) Every new connection pays DNS, TCP handshake (1 RTT) and TLS before data; reuse connections, preconnect to critical origins, use HTTP/2 or 3. 2) Distance is physics (about 28 ms one way New York-London), so move content closer (CDN, edge cache). 3) Cut requests and bytes on the critical path; inline or preload the critical CSS and fonts. 4) Then fix rendering cost: layout, paint, raster and compositing work. 5) Judge by field metrics (LCP, INP, CLS) not only lab scores. **أرقام / params:** RTT, field metrics
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3436-systems-architecture/14110-high-perf-browser`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): systems-architecture/high-perf-browser (#14110) · theme performance · 2 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/3436-systems-architecture/14110-high-perf-browser

#### ACODE-238 · تشخيص أعطال تكامل SaaS المستعصية طبقةً طبقة · Layer-by-layer deep debugging of a stubborn SaaS integration · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعزل العطل المتقطع أو الغامض في تكامل مع خدمة خارجية بفحص كل طبقة على حدة حتى أول طبقة تفشل، ويجمع أدلة جاهزة للتصعيد للمزوّد. — Isolates an intermittent or puzzling third-party integration failure by testing each layer independently until the first failing one, and packages escalation-ready evidence.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** فشل متقطع، أخطاء throttling غير مفهومة، webhooks تختفي، التشخيص العادي لم يكفِ / intermittent failures, unexplained throttling, missing webhooks, standard troubleshooting exhausted
- **كيف / how:** 1) Write down the exact symptom, first-seen time, affected tenant or table, and whether it is continuous or intermittent. 2) Probe each layer on its own with a harmless request: DNS/TLS, vendor auth, the vendor API call, your callback or webhook endpoint, your queue and worker; the first layer that fails is where to dig. 3) Turn on any vendor cost or debug headers and capture the vendor request ID from every response. 4) For query-cost APIs (e.g. GraphQL), compute requested cost from page size multiplied through nested connections before blaming the vendor. 5) Check the vendor's delivery log for webhooks and compare with what you received. 6) Wrap calls in a timing/error logger for a bounded window to find patterns by time, payload size or tenant. 7) Hand over: symptom, failing layer, request IDs, timings, minimal repro; never include keys or customer data. #### ACODE-243 · قياس صحة تكامل خارجي ونتائجه بمقامات صريحة · Integration observability with explicit denominators · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعرّف مقاييس تكامل خارجي (تبنٍّ، زمن، جودة، استخدام، حوادث) من مصادر موثقة للمزوّد مع حفظ المقام لكل نسبة، ولا يستنتج أكثر مما تسمح به العينة. — Defines integration metrics from documented vendor sources, keeps the denominator of every rate, and does not infer beyond the sample.

#### ACODE-121 · التحقق من استعادة النسخ الاحتياطي · Backup restore verification and DR rehearsal · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** اشتقاق جدول النسخ من RPO/RTO واستعادة اختبارية دورية. — Derive backup cadence from RPO/RTO and schedule isolated test restores measuring real restore time.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Backups unproven or setting RPO/RTO.
- **كيف / how:** 1) RPO sets cadence (continuous WAL for PITR, else full+incremental). 2) Store in separate failure domain, encrypted, immutable, retention. 3) Scheduled restore to isolated instance. 4) Validate row counts/checksums/smoke query. 5) Compare restore time to RTO; alert when stale. 6) Game-day restore-and-promote. **أرقام / params:** RPO, RTO

#### ACODE-125 · تصميم خط CI: ترتيب وتخزين مؤقت · CI pipeline design: ordering, caching, required checks · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تصميم خط CI سريع وحتمي ببوابات مرتبة حسب الكلفة وتخزين مؤقت. — Design a fast deterministic CI pipeline with cost-ordered gates, lockfile caching and aggregated required checks.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Setting up or speeding up CI, branch protection, flaky jobs.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Order gates cheapest first: format, lint, typecheck, unit, build, integration, e2e. 2) Cache deps keyed on lockfile hash; build cache on inputs. 3) Matrix versions/OS and shard slow suites. 4) One fan-in aggregate required check. 5) Quarantine flaky jobs, never require them. 6) Pin third-party actions to SHA; use OIDC not long-lived keys.

#### ACODE-159 · حكم LLM معايَر ومدقَّق التحيز · Calibrated, bias-audited LLM-as-judge · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تصميم حكم LLM بمعايير مرسّاة وقرار منظم ومعايرة مقابل التقييم البشري. — Design an LLM judge with anchored rubric levels, structured verdicts, pinned model and human-agreement calibration.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Any time an LLM grades outputs or A/B pairs before its numbers are trusted.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Define per-criterion anchored levels (0/1/2), not 1-10. 2) Judge returns {criterion: level, reason}. 3) Prefer pairwise with randomized A/B side. 4) Pin judge model, version, temperature and log them. 5) Label 30-50 samples by humans, compute raw agreement or Cohen kappa, fix rubric if low. 6) Audit position, verbosity, self-preference, leniency drift; recalibrate on any judge/rubric change. **أرقام / params:** rubric criteria; sample size 30-50
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

- **ماذا / what:** بناء وكلاء LangGraph صحيحين بحالة typed ونقاط حفظ وintrrupt بشري وgraphs فرعية. — Build correct LangGraph agents with typed state, checkpointers, thread_id discipline, human interrupts and subgraphs.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Adding chat memory, approval flows, streaming or subgraphs to a LangGraph agent.
- **كيف / how:** 1) TypedDict state, JSON-safe values only (no datetime/Decimal). 2) Checkpointer by env: MemorySaver dev, SqliteSaver local, PostgresSaver/Async prod. 3) Always pass config configurable thread_id (UUID4 per conversation) or memory silently resets. 4) interrupt_before for approvals. 5) Pick stream_mode messages vs updates. 6) Migrate Postgres checkpoint schema explicitly on upgrade. 7) Use time-travel to debug. **أرقام / params:** thread_id strategy
