#### ACODE-170 · تدقيق ذاكرة الـprompt المؤقتة وإصلاحها · Prompt-cache hit-rate audit and fix · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تشخيص انخفاض إصابة الكاش من حقول الاستخدام وإصلاح موضع نقاط التوقف. — Diagnose low prompt-cache hit rate from usage fields and fix breakpoint placement.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Cache hit under 80%, cost spike, or designing a new endpoint.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens from usage; hit = read/(read+creation), target >=80%. 2) Diff two raw payloads: tools array mutating, breakpoint below volatile content. 3) Check per-model minimum block size, max 4 breakpoints, TTL (5min vs 1h at 2x creation). 4) Freeze tools/system in constants. 5) Warm-up call, then 10 identical-prefix calls; measure over 1h.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT/Apache-2.0; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-171 · دليل بناء وضبط خط RAG · RAG pipeline build and tuning guide · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** بناء خط RAG إنتاجي بإعدادات افتراضية سليمة وترقية كل مرحلة عند ظهور فشل مقيس. — Build a production RAG pipeline from sane defaults and upgrade each stage only against measured failures.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Building or choosing chunking, embeddings, vector DB, hybrid search or reranking for RAG.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Start: recursive split ~512 tokens with 10-15% overlap. 2) Embed with a value model; keep metric matching training. 3) Vector DB with INT8 quantization. 4) Hybrid dense+sparse fused by RRF. 5) Evaluate with RAGAS from day one. 6) Upgrade by failure: keyword misses add BM25/SPLADE; ambiguous chunks add contextual retrieval; noise add cross-encoder rerank; multi-hop go agentic. **أرقام / params:** chunk size; embedding model; vector DB

#### ACODE-195 · تصنيف نتائج regex قبل الاستبدال الجماعي · Classify regex matches before bulk sweep · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصنف كل مطابقة قبل الاستبدال الجماعي لتجنب إفساد الملفات المصممة والسجلات التاريخية. — Bucket every match of a bulk find-replace into stale target, false positive, out-of-scope design, or immutable record before editing.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Renaming commands, tools, paths or syntax across many files, especially docs mixing live text with ADRs/changelogs.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Decide target: code goes to ast-grep structural rewrite, prose goes to regex. 2) Enumerate all matches with rg and read the surrounding line. 3) Bucket into: transform / leave false positive / leave designed filename (delimiter also in file names) / supersede-note historical record. 4) Apply scoped transform only to bucket 1. 5) Verify with allowlist-aware grep that leftovers are only buckets 2-4.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-198 · إدارة مهام todo.md عبر سكربتات · Markdown todo file task scripts · 📄 موصوف / documented only

Never read the file directly.

#### ACODE-219 · منع رفع الأسرار عند الالتزام · Block secrets at commit time · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يفحص ما سيُلتزم به قبل الرفع بماسح أسرار، لأن المفتاح بعد الدفع لا يُحذف بل يُدوّر. — Scans what is about to be committed with a secret scanner, because once pushed a key cannot be deleted, only rotated.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** منع تسريب المفاتيح، فحص الأسرار قبل commit / prevent committing secrets, pre-commit secret scan
- **كيف / how:** 1) A hook file is not proof: many pre-commit hooks only format and exit 0; check that one actually scans. 2) Scan staged content directly with a scanner in staged mode and with redaction so the finding does not print the secret into logs or transcripts. 3) Staged mode ignores untracked files: check env-like files and .gitignore before a future 'add -A'. 4) Install repo-locally through a versioned pre-commit config; committing the config protects nobody until each clone installs it. 5) After a leak, rotate the key; deleting the line is not containment.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3346-prevent-committing-secrets/13861-prevent-committing-secrets`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): prevent-committing-secrets/prevent-committing-secrets (#13861) · theme security · 1 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/3346-prevent-committing-secrets/13861-prevent-committing-secrets

#### ACODE-221 · التحقق من السلوك لا من التفاصيل الداخلية، بأوامر المستودع نفسه · Behaviour-level assertions per layer, with the repo's own commands · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتب تحققات تشبه طريقة استخدام البرنامج فعلاً في كل طبقة، ويكتشف أوامر المستودع قبل أي شيء؛ دورة الأحمر والأخضر نفسها في CODE-08. — Asserts only what each layer's user can observe and discovers the repository's own commands first; the red-green loop itself is CODE-08.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** الاختبارات تنكسر عند إعادة الهيكلة، ماذا أتحقق منه / brittle tests, what to assert, tests break on refactor
- **كيف / how:** 1) Principle: the closer a check is to how the software is used, the more confidence it gives. 2) Assert only on what the user of that layer can observe: return values, errors and public types for a library; status and body for an API; visible text and roles for a UI; never private helpers. 3) Checks bound to internals fail on harmless refactors and stay green on real breakage. 4) For a bug, reproduce it first, then fix (prove-it); the red-green-refactor loop is CODE-08. 5) Discover the stack before writing anything: build files, checked-in wrappers (./gradlew, make), framework, neighbouring conventions and the commands CI runs; run the focused command in the loop and the full suite before finishing; never assume 'npm test'.
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`node`](../requirements.md#req-node)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2586-testing-philosophy/9953-testing-philosophy` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2110-base-dev-kit/7507-tdd`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): testing-philosophy/testing-philosophy (#9953); base-dev-kit/tdd (#7507) · theme testing-tdd · 2 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/2586-testing-philosophy/9953-testing-philosophy, skills/2110-base-dev-kit/7507-tdd

#### ACODE-222 · قاعدة الاعتماد في البنية النظيفة · Clean Architecture dependency rule · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ينظم الكود في دوائر بحيث تشير الاعتمادات للداخل نحو قواعد العمل، فيمكن تبديل قاعدة البيانات أو الإطار دون لمس المنطق. — Organises code in circles whose dependencies point inward to business rules, so the database or framework can change without touching logic.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** هيكلة المشروع، فصل المنطق عن الإطار، بنية نظيفة / clean architecture, separate business logic, layering
- **كيف / how:** 1) Circles: entities, use cases, interface adapters, frameworks and drivers. 2) Inner circles never name anything from outer ones (classes, functions, data formats). 3) Data crossing a boundary takes the shape the inner circle prefers. 4) Use dependency inversion: interfaces defined inward, implemented outward. 5) Score seven diagnostic rows (framework independence, testable use cases, swappable UI and DB...) and map 6-7 to 9-10.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3436-systems-architecture/14108-clean-architecture`

#### ACODE-224 · قياس التحسين مقابل خط أساس مُلتقط قبل التغيير · Measure improvement against a baseline captured before · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** لا يدّعي تحسناً إلا بقياس قبل التغيير وبعده بالشروط نفسها، وإن غاب القياس الأول يقول ذلك صراحة. — Claims an improvement only with before and after measurements under the same conditions, and says so when no baseline exists.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** هل تحسّن الأداء فعلاً، قارن قبل وبعد / did it get faster, before and after benchmark
- **كيف / how:** 1) When a plan states a measurable goal, capture the baseline at planning time and store it with the task. 2) After the change re-measure with the same tool, input and environment, and report the delta. 3) No baseline: report 'baseline not captured', give the after-number only, and do not call it an improvement. 4) Repeat runs and report spread, not one lucky number. 5) Same rule as KOSIF FusionForge --baseline. **أرقام / params:** metric, runs
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-225 · jq: نموذج المرشّح لتدفق JSON · jq filter mental model for JSON streams · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعالج JSON من سطر الأوامر بفهم أن برنامج jq مرشّح يحوّل تدفق قيم إلى تدفق قيم. — Processes JSON on the command line by treating a jq program as a filter from a stream of values to a stream of values.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** استخراج من JSON، فلترة JSON في الطرفية / filter JSON, jq query, extract fields
- **كيف / how:** 1) A filter takes one JSON value and emits zero, one or many; '.' is identity, '.[]' emits each element, 'select' can emit nothing. 2) Pipe filters with '|' like a shell. 3) It is pure: assignment returns a modified copy. 4) It runs once per input value; use -s to slurp a stream into one array, -r for raw strings, -c for one line per value. 5) Deterministic stdin to stdout, ideal for CI and agents.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-200 · تقسيم التغييرات إلى commits ذرية · Atomic commit splitting by purpose · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تجميع التغييرات حسب الغرض وإنشاء commits منطقية متعددة أو دمج الإصلاحات في commits سابقة. — Group a dirty working tree by purpose and create several logical commits, or fold fixes into earlier commits.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Large uncommitted diff, review feedback touching older commits, messy history.
- **كيف / how:** 1) git diff --stat and group hunks by purpose. 2) git add -p or per-file staging, commit each group. 3) For review fixes: stage changes, git absorb --base main (only own commits, default last 10) then git rebase -i --autosquash. 4) Verify git absorb --version first; do not auto-install. 5) Reword messages in bulk if needed. **أرقام / params:** base=main

#### ACODE-203 · رسالة commit بصيغة Conventional من التغييرات · Conventional commit from staged diff · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** توليد رسالة commit بصيغة Conventional Commits من الفروقات المجهزة مع تجهيز ملفات محددة فقط. — Derive a Conventional Commits 1.0 message (type, scope, body) from the staged diff after staging specific files only.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User asks to commit, write a commit message, or enforce commit style.
- **كيف / how:** 1) git status --short and git diff --cached --name-only; unstage .env*, keys, binaries, build artifacts. 2) Never git add . or -A; stage named files via NUL-delimited array. 3) Read git diff --cached, infer type(scope) and imperative subject. 4) Put why in body; mention BREAKING CHANGE footer. 5) Show message for review, then commit; no AI attribution if repo forbids. **أرقام / params:** target=staged|all; style=single-line|body

#### ACODE-205 · محاكاة تعارضات قائمة الدمج · Merge queue conflict simulation · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** التنبؤ بالتعارضات بين فروع قائمة الدمج دون لمس المراجع أو شجرة العمل. — Predict which branches in a merge queue conflict without touching refs, index or worktree.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Several PRs edit the same registry/changelog; choosing merge order.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Start from base commit. 2) git merge-tree --write-tree base_c branch writes merged tree and prints OID (plain two-branch merge-tree is wrong for queues). 3) Wrap with git commit-tree -p base_c -p branch to chain, no refs. 4) Nonzero exit means conflict; read stage 1/2/3 output. 5) Try orders, preview final file; clean temp order file. **أرقام / params:** branches,order
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-209 · إزالة أسرار دُفعت من السجل المستضاف · Purge pushed secrets from hosted history · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** بعد force-push يجب التحقق من بقاء الكوميتات القديمة وإعادة إنشاء المستودع. — After force-push, verify old commits remain served and recreate repo to truly unpublish.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Sensitive data pushed then rewritten; going public.

#### ACODE-212 · تقسيم فرع إلى فروع بكوميت واحد · Split branch into one-commit branches · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تحويل فرع فيه N كوميت إلى N فروع بكوميت واحد عبر cherry-pick دون المساس بالأصلي. — Turn a branch of N commits into N single-commit branches via cherry-pick without touching the original.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Reviewers want small PRs from one large branch.
- **كيف / how:** 1) git log --oneline --reverse base..HEAD; stop if 0 or 1 commits. 2) Propose kebab-case names (3-5 words) from subjects, get approval. 3) For each commit oldest first: skip if branch tip equals sha, else suffix -2; git branch name base; git switch; git cherry-pick sha. 4) On conflict leave branch conflicted, continue, report. 5) Switch back; never delete or force-push. **أرقام / params:** base
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-213 · طلبات دمج متراكبة عبر gh stack · Stacked PRs with gh stack · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إرسال ومزامنة وتعديل ودمج طلبات الدمج المتراكبة على GitHub. — Submit, sync, navigate, amend and merge GitHub-native stacked pull requests.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Dependent branches or chained PRs need to stay rebased on trunk.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Check tooling readiness (gh stack). 2) Submit: stage specific files, conventional commit, gh stack submit --auto (draft; --open to publish). 3) gh stack sync to rebase on trunk, prune merged. 4) Amend folds working-tree changes into current commit and resubmits. 5) gh stack merge; cleanup unstacks. Alternative: git-chain for local chains.

#### ACODE-214 · طلبات دمج متراكمة مع Graphite وMergify · Stacked PRs with Graphite or Mergify · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إدارة سلسلة فروع بالتتابع عبر gt أو mergify: إنشاء ورفع وإعادة ترتيب ودمج. — Drive a stack of one-commit branches via gt or mergify stack, submit, sync, restack and merge in order.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Stacked diffs, split a big change into reviewable PRs.
- **كيف / how:** 1) gt create -am msg per layer (one commit per branch). 2) gt submit --stack. 3) Amend via gt modify, never raw git rebase on tracked branches. 4) gt sync: pull trunk, restack, untrack merged. 5) Merge trunk-up. 6) Mergify: push stack, merge queue, Depends-On protections. **أرقام / params:** trunk, stack scope

- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Complete issue #N, start issue, parallel agents.

#### ACODE-216 · إدارة worktree وتنظيفها بأمان · Worktree lifecycle and safe cleanup · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إنشاء worktree لكل مهمة وحذف worktrees والفروع المدموجة دون إجبار. — Create sibling worktrees per task and remove worktrees and merged branches without force.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Parallel tasks, dirty tree blocks switching, cleanup after merge.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Create in peer dir: git worktree add ../repo-feature -b feature base. 2) Keep main checkout on default branch. 3) Cleanup: git worktree list, remove only clean ones (no --force), git worktree prune. 4) Delete gone branches: git fetch -p, list [gone], git branch -d. 5) Fix worktree created inside repo by moving with git worktree move.

#### ACODE-227 · ضبط ruff للفحص والتنسيق دون فخ select · ruff lint and format without the select trap · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعتمد ruff كفاحص ومنسق لبايثون مع فهم أن select يستبدل القواعد الافتراضية ولا يضيف إليها. — Adopts ruff as Python linter and formatter, knowing that select replaces the default rule set while extend-select adds to it.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** إعداد فحص كود بايثون أو الانتقال من flake8/black/isort / setting up Python lint, migrating from flake8/black/isort
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pin the version (required-version / pre-commit rev): ruff 0.x treats a minor bump as breaking. 2) Add categories with extend-select, subtract with ignore; use select only for a locked list. 3) Run ruff check --fix then ruff format (format does not sort imports; the I rules do). 4) In CI: ruff check (exit 1 = violations, exit 2 = broken config) and ruff format --check. 5) Look rules up with ruff rule CODE, never guess; prefer # noqa: CODE over blanket noqa. 6) Remember config is nearest-file-wins (use extend to share) and that recent ruff also formats Python blocks in Markdown. **أرقام / params:** ruff version
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`python3`](../requirements.md#req-python3)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACODE-228 · إدارة مشاريع بايثون والسكربتات ببرنامج uv · Python projects, scripts and tools with uv · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يدير الحزم والبيئات وإصدارات بايثون بأداة واحدة: مشروع بملف قفل شامل، سكربتات PEP 723، وأدوات عابرة بـ uvx. — Manages packages, environments and Python versions with one tool: locked projects, PEP 723 scripts and one-off tools via uvx.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** إعداد مشروع بايثون، تشغيل سكربت باعتمادياته، CI قابل للتكرار / new Python project, running a script with its deps, reproducible CI
- **كيف / how:** 1) Project: uv init, uv add PKG (updates pyproject, uv.lock and .venv together), uv run CMD; commit uv.lock, ignore .venv. 2) Single script: declare deps in a # /// script block and run uv run script.py in an ephemeral env. 3) One-off tools: uvx TOOL@version; persistent: uv tool install. 4) CI: uv lock --check, then uv sync --frozen and uv run --frozen pytest. 5) Pin Python with uv python pin; treat uv minor bumps as breaking and check uv --version. 6) uv pip is a separate pip-compatible interface that never touches pyproject or the lock. **أرقام / params:** python version
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`python3`](../requirements.md#req-python3)

#### ACODE-316 · أداء React وNext.js بالأولوية: اقتل الشلالات والحزمة أولًا، ثم الخادم، ثم إعادة الرسم، ومراجعة بنمط diff أو كامل مع ESLint كحقيقة أرضية · React and Next.js performance by impact: kill waterfalls and bundle bloat first, then server work, then re-renders; review in diff or full mode with ESLint as ground truth · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ترتيب قواعد أداء React حسب الأثر: (1) الشلالات غير المتزامنة و(2) حجم الحزمة حرجان، ثم أداء الخادم، ثم جلب العميل، ثم إعادة الرسم، ثم الرسم، ثم JavaScript الخام. المراجعة تبدأ من الملفات المتغيرة فقط ما لم يُطلب فحص كامل، وتأخذ ناتج ESLint كدليل لا يُتجاوز. — Impact-ordered React performance rules and a scoped review.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** React بطيء، حجم الحزمة كبير، راجع أداء React، Next.js تحميل بطيء / React or Next.js performance review or refactor
- **كيف / how:** 1) Scope: if React files changed and no --full flag, review only `git diff HEAD -- <react files>`; otherwise scan src/, app/, components/, pages/. Stop and say so if no React files exist. 2) Run the project's ESLint (react-hooks, react-compiler rules if configured) first and pass its output as ground truth. 3) Waterfalls (critical): check cheap sync conditions before awaiting remote values; move await into the branch that uses it; Promise.all independent work; in API routes start promises early, await late; stream slow parts behind Suspense. 4) Bundle (critical): import from the module, not a barrel file; keep import paths statically analysable; next/dynamic for heavy components; load analytics and logging after hydration; load a module only when its feature is on; preload on hover or focus. 5) Server: authenticate server actions like API routes; React.cache() for per-request dedupe and an LRU for cross-request; never keep request state in module-level mutables in RSC/SSR; pass the minimum data across the server-client boundary and do not serialise the same object twice; hoist static I/O to module scope. 6) Only then re-render and rendering rules (stable identities where measured, derived state, virtualise long lists) and JS micro-optimisations. 7) Report per finding: file and line, rule prefix (async-, bundle-, server-, client-, rerender-, rendering-, js-), impact level, the fix, and whether it was measured. #### ACODE-317 · صحة مكونات React: عقد المشروع أولًا، الحالة عند مالكها، الاشتقاق أثناء الرسم، Effect فقط لمزامنة نظام خارجي داخل hook مسمى، وref كملاذ أخير · React component correctness: local contract first, state at its owner, derive during render, Effects only to sync an external system inside a named hook, refs as a last resort · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** قواعد React العملية: افحص النسخ والمكان (خادم أو عميل) وReact Compiler قبل التعديل، احفظ تصميم وAPI المكونات، اتبع Rules of React، لا تنسخ الحالة نسختين، واجعل useEffect للمزامنة مع نظام خارجي فقط ومعزولًا في hook باسم مسؤوليته. ويشمل ترحيل الأصناف إلى hooks وترقيات React 17/18. — Rules of React applied to real edits.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مكون React فيه باغ، useEffect كثير، حالة متزامنة مرتين، ترقية React، تحويل class إلى hooks / React component bugs, effects, refs, upgrades
- **كيف / how:** 1) Establish the contract: installed React and framework versions, whether the code runs on server, client or both, whether React Compiler is on, existing state and data libraries; preserve design, component APIs and styling unless the task says otherwise; read the official docs for the installed version before changing an API contract. 2) Keep rendering pure and props and state immutable; fix the cause of a hooks lint error, never suppress it. 3) Put each piece of state with its consumers or their nearest shared owner; reuse router state, server caches and store selectors; an editable draft is a separate value with an explicit save or reset. 4) Replace Effects: compute derived data during render, put user-action work in the event handler, reset state on entity change with a `key`, cache expensive computation with useMemo, fetch through the project's data library. 5) Keep useEffect only for browser APIs (IntersectionObserver, ResizeObserver), third-party widget setup and teardown, or external connections; pair every subscription or timer with cleanup that survives dependency changes and remounts; extract it into a hook named for its job (useDocumentTitle, useWindowResize). 6) Before useRef try native HTML (details, dialog, popover, input type=date), a declarative library, state, or a closure; when a ref is truly needed (canvas, scroll position, a third-party instance) hide it in a custom hook. 7) File hygiene where the project agrees: styles, then Props type, then the component; one component per file except a tiny commented render-prop helper; split when logic before the JSX passes about 30 lines or the JSX branches become hard to track. 8) Upgrades: React 17 (event delegation, no pooling, new JSX transform), React 18 (createRoot, automatic batching, StrictMode double invoke, transitions, Suspense); migrate class lifecycles to hooks one component at a time and use the official codemods. 9) Verify with the project's typecheck, lint and tests, and say which did not run. #### ACODE-318 · Next.js App Router (حتى v16): اكتشف الراوتر والنسخة وcacheComponents قبل الكتابة، مكونات خادم افتراضيًا، 'use client' عند الحد فقط، و'use cache' بدل خيارات fetch · Next.js App Router up to v16: detect router, version and cacheComponents before writing; Server Components by default, 'use client' only at the boundary, 'use cache' instead of fetch options · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** سلوك Next.js يختلف جذريًا بين 14 و15 و16 وبين App وPages Router، وتفعيل cacheComponents يغير نموذج التخزين المؤقت كله. البطاقة تفرض اكتشاف السياق ثم قواعد الحدود بين الخادم والعميل والتخزين المؤقت والتوجيه المتوازي. — Next.js routing, rendering and caching without version mix-ups.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مشروع Next.js، App Router، Server Actions، use cache، ترحيل من pages إلى app / building or migrating a Next.js app
- **كيف / how:** 1) Detect before writing: app/ or pages/ router (ask if unclear), Next version from package.json, `cacheComponents: true` in next.config, TS or JS. 2) Start with Server Components; add 'use client' only at the interactive boundary, since its children become client code; props crossing it must be serialisable (no functions, class instances or Symbols). 3) Mutations through 'use server' Server Actions, authenticated and validated like an API route. 4) With cacheComponents on, cache routes, components or functions with 'use cache'; the key is build ID plus function ID plus serialisable arguments including captured variables; do not read cookies or headers inside a cached scope. 5) Without it, follow the installed version's fetch caching defaults; check them, they changed between 14 and 15. 6) Colocate data fetching, wrap slow parts in Suspense or loading.tsx, use parallel routes for independent loading states and intercepting routes for modals. 7) Migrate Pages to App one route at a time; both routers can coexist. 8) Verify with next build (it type-checks and reports static vs dynamic per route) and the project's tests. #### ACODE-319 · اكتب بلغة المشروع حسب ملفات أدواته: اقرأ go.mod وpyproject وCargo.toml وtsconfig وcsproj والـCI قبل أي API مقيدة بنسخة، ثم افتراضيات كل لغة، و'تم' فقط بعد الفحوص أو بتسمية ما لم يعمل · Write each language from its toolchain files: read go.mod, pyproject, Cargo.toml, tsconfig, csproj and CI before any version-gated API, then per-language defaults; done only when checks pass or each unrun check is named · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مجموعة افتراضيات مختصرة لـ Go وPython وRust وTypeScript وC#/.NET وJava/Kotlin، يحكمها مبدأ واحد: أعراف المشروع وملفات نسخته تتقدم على الافتراضيات، ولا تُستخدم ميزة لغة أحدث من المعلن. — Per-language defaults gated by the project's declared versions.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب كود Go أو Python أو Rust أو TypeScript أو C# أو Kotlin في مستودع قائم / writing code in an existing repo of these languages
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the version sources first: Go `go.mod` go and toolchain lines; Python `pyproject.toml`, `.python-version`; Rust `Cargo.toml` rust-version and edition, `rust-toolchain.toml`; TypeScript nearest package.json and tsconfig (name the package in a monorepo); C# `*.csproj`, `Directory.Build.props`, `global.json` (TargetFramework, LangVersion, nullable); JVM build files; plus the CI matrix. 2) Stdlib and existing dependencies first; ask before adding a schema, form, query or state library the project lacks. 3) Go: concrete types, small consumer-owned interfaces, cmd/<name> plus internal/, no package stutter, every goroutine with an owner and a cancel and completion path, main calls run(ctx, args, stdin, stdout, stderr) error, no log.Fatal; 1.24+ t.Context(), 1.25+ WaitGroup.Go. 4) Python: uv for env and commands, ruff, pyright or ty if adopted, pytest; 3.12+ typing only on 3.12+ modules; frozen slotted dataclasses, TypedDict at JSON edges, `raise ... from exc`, TaskGroup and asyncio.timeout, explicit encoding, sorted globs; main(argv) -> int. 5) Rust: stay within MSRV and edition; newtypes and enums; From/TryFrom/FromStr/Display before ad-hoc methods; typed Result errors, unwrap only with a named invariant; fix data flow before clone(); never hold a blocking guard across .await; bound queues; `// SAFETY:` on small unsafe blocks; never cargo clean as a routine fix. 6) TypeScript: never weaken compiler options; new configs get strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noImplicitOverride, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch; moduleResolution Bundler for bundled apps, NodeNext for Node libraries and servers; treat JSON, env, storage and SDK output as unknown and narrow at the boundary; discriminated unions with exhaustive never; thread AbortSignal; plain function components, memo only for measured cost. 7) C#: nullable on, async end to end with CancellationToken, no singleton capturing a scoped service, validate DTOs at the handler, ValidateOnStart options, background services honour the stopping token. 8) CLIs in every language: thin entry point, test the run seam, assert exit code and stderr on bad input; config precedence flag, env, file, default. 9) Done only when the relevant build, test and lint checks pass on what changed, or each check that did not run is named with the reason. #### ACODE-320 · Go الاصطلاحي والتزامن: الوضوح ثم البساطة ثم الإيجاز، أخطاء مبكرة بلا تداخل، ولكل goroutine مالك وسياق إلغاء ومخرج، وerrgroup للأخطاء المشتركة · Idiomatic Go and concurrency: clarity, then simplicity, then concision; early error returns; every goroutine has an owner, a context and an exit; errgroup for shared errors · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** قواعد Go من Effective Go ودليل Google وCode Review Comments بترتيب حسم واضح عند التعارض (وضوح، بساطة، إيجاز، قابلية صيانة، اتساق)، مع أنماط التزامن الآمنة: من يرسل يغلق القناة، لا تسرب goroutines، context للإلغاء والمهل، والإيقاف اللطيف. — Go style and concurrency rules with a conflict order.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب أو راجع كود Go، goroutine تتسرب، race condition، worker pool، إيقاف لطيف، Cobra CLI / writing or reviewing Go
- **كيف / how:** 1) Run the project's checks first (make lint or fmt, gofmt, goimports, golangci-lint, go vet) and keep their output as evidence. 2) Resolve style conflicts in this order: clarity to a reader who did not write the code, simplicity, concision, maintainability, consistency with surrounding code. 3) Handle errors early and keep the happy path unindented; wrap with %w and context, check with errors.Is/As, never both log and return the same error. 4) Concurrency: pass context.Context first for cancellation and deadlines; only the sender closes a channel; every goroutine has an exit path; use errgroup when siblings share errors or cancellation; buffer a channel only when the count is known; prefer channels for ownership hand-off and a mutex for small shared state; run tests with -race. 5) Worker pools and pipelines: bounded workers, a done or ctx case in every select, drain or cancel on early return. 6) Graceful shutdown: signal.NotifyContext, stop accepting, wait for in-flight work with a timeout. 7) Cobra roots: SilenceUsage on runtime errors, RunE not Run, errors to stderr with a non-zero exit. 8) Tests: table-driven with t.Run names, compare with cmp.Diff, small Fn-field fakes instead of mock frameworks. 9) Done when a checklist review passes, not just when it compiles. #### ACODE-321 · Rust اصطلاحي: صمم البيانات قبل الكود، ملكية واستعارة قبل clone، Tokio وSerde بحدود واضحة، وclippy وrustfmt وnextest وllvm-cov كبوابات · Idiomatic Rust: model data before code, ownership and borrowing before clone, Tokio and Serde with clear boundaries, clippy, rustfmt, nextest and llvm-cov as gates · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** منهج كتابة Rust: افهم الطلب، خطط هياكل البيانات بدقة (structs وenums وtraits)، اكتب تنفيذًا اصطلاحيًا موثقًا، استخدم الماكرو بحذر، واهتم بزمن البناء وتقسيم الوحدات، مع أدوات النظام البيئي الحديث وإصدار 2024. — Rust design and tooling workflow.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب كود Rust، صمم crate، async مع Tokio، مشاكل borrow checker، تحسين زمن البناء / writing Rust
- **كيف / how:** 1) Restate the request and its constraints (performance, no_std, MSRV, edition). 2) Model with types: newtypes for IDs and validated values, enums for states, traits only for real polymorphism; make illegal states unrepresentable. 3) Write ownership-first code: borrow where possible, return owned values at API edges, lifetimes only for real zero-copy. 4) Async: Tokio only at the I/O boundary; spawn with JoinSet; never block the runtime (spawn_blocking); bounded mpsc channels. 5) Serde derives with explicit rename and deny_unknown_fields at untrusted boundaries. 6) Document public items with examples that run as doctests; follow rustfmt; fix clippy pedantic findings that apply rather than allow-listing. 7) Macros only when they remove real repetition; prefer generics. 8) Build speed: split crates in a workspace, trim features, use cargo check while editing, sccache or mold where allowed. 9) Gates before finishing: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo nextest run (or cargo test), cargo llvm-cov when coverage matters, cargo machete for unused deps. 10) Offer an alternative design when a trade-off is real. #### ACODE-322 · صور حاويات حسب اللغة: Go ثابت على scratch مع شهادات CA، وNode متعدد المراحل بذاكرة BuildKit واعتماديات إنتاج فقط، وPython على slim لا Alpine بنسخة واحدة للمرحلتين · Language-specific container images: static Go on scratch with CA certs, multi-stage Node with BuildKit cache and production-only deps, Python on slim not Alpine with one version for both stages · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تحسينات خاصة بكل لغة فوق نمط البناء متعدد المراحل العام: Go من 846MB إلى بضعة MB، وNode بين 100-150MB، وPython بين 80-120MB، مع فخاخ حقيقية: venv لا ينتقل بين نسخ Python الصغرى، وAlpine يكسر عجلات numpy/pandas، وdistroless بلا shell. — Per-language Dockerfile optimisation with the traps that bite.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** صورة Docker كبيرة، Dockerfile لـ Go أو Node أو Python، ModuleNotFoundError في الحاوية، تقليل حجم الصورة / optimising a Go, Node or Python image
- **كيف / how:** 1) Go: build with CGO_ENABLED=0, -trimpath and -ldflags='-s -w' in a golang builder; run on scratch or distroless/static; copy /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt (and zoneinfo if used) for HTTPS; USER a non-root UID; if CGO is required, use distroless/base or a glibc base instead. 2) Node: multi-stage, install with the lockfile's manager (npm ci, yarn --immutable, pnpm --frozen-lockfile) using a BuildKit cache mount; build in one stage, copy only production node_modules and the build output into the runtime stage; Next.js serves .next/standalone with Node even when Bun built it; a distroless runtime has no shell, so code that shells out to CLIs fails there. 3) Never re-add a package after a frozen install with an unpinned `add`, which resolves the registry's latest tag outside the lockfile; pin it or move it to dependencies. 4) Python: python:<ver>-slim, not Alpine (musl breaks many wheels and forces source builds); uv sync --frozen --no-dev into /app/.venv in the builder, copy the venv to the runtime. 5) Drive both FROM lines from one ARG PYTHON_VERSION: a venv copied to a different minor version drops out of sys.path entirely, and the symptom is ModuleNotFoundError on the first non-stdlib import. 6) Check it with a build-time assertion that runs the entrypoint's imports in the final stage, and group Renovate updates for both stages. 7) Measure: docker image ls size before and after, docker history for fat layers, and a smoke run of the real entrypoint. #### ACODE-323 · فحوص Python السريعة من Astral وأخواتها: ty كمدقق أنواع تجريبي بنسخة مثبتة، وترحيل mypy إلى ty وblack إلى ruff format بخطاف محلي، وvulture للكود الميت بقائمة سماح · Fast Python checks: ty as a pinned beta type checker, mypy to ty and black to ruff-format migrations with a local pre-commit hook, vulture for dead code with a whitelist · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ty سريع جدًا ويعمل على كود جزئي الأنواع، لكنه 0.0.x تتغير أعلامه وأسماء قواعده بين الإصدارات الصغيرة، فيجب تثبيت النسخة والتحقق من --help. الترحيلات تتم بتدقيق الإعداد الحالي ثم الاستبدال ثم التحقق، مع إبقاء mypy حين يعتمد المشروع على إضافاته. — Adopting ty, ruff-format and vulture safely.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** استخدم ty، انقل من mypy، استبدل black بـ ruff، كود ميت في Python / Python type checking, formatting or dead-code cleanup
- **كيف / how:** 1) Confirm the build: `ty --version`; pin it in the hook or dev dependencies; check `ty check --help` and `ty explain rule <name>` instead of recalled rule names. 2) Mental model: inference-first, unannotated symbols are Unknown, no --strict (defaults are already strict), each rule is error, warn or ignore, set per rule and per file pattern with [[overrides]]. 3) Most failures are environment discovery: point ty at the project venv (uv run ty check, or configure the python environment) before judging errors. 4) Suppress with ty's bracketed rule code, not a blanket ignore; adopt on an existing codebase by starting noisy rules at warn and ratcheting. 5) mypy to ty: audit .pre-commit-config.yaml, [tool.mypy] and mypy.ini; keep mypy if the project relies on mypy plugins, dmypy or mypy-specific exit codes; otherwise replace the mirrors-mypy hook with a `repo: local` hook running `uvx ty@<pin> check`, translate config into [tool.ty], run both once and compare. 6) black to ruff format: move [tool.black] line-length and target into [tool.ruff] / [tool.ruff.format], replace the psf/black hook with ruff-format, drop black from dependencies, run ruff format --check and expect a near-empty diff. 7) Dead code: vulture with --min-confidence 80 for gradual cleanup and a generated whitelist for framework entry points, or deadcode for strict new projects; unused imports alone belong to ruff F401. 8) Report the before and after counts per check. #### ACODE-324 · سكربت Python مساعد أصغر ما يمكن مقابل سكربت تسليمي: مكتبة قياسية وبلا تهيئة مشروع للمساعد، وحدود مكتوبة الأنواع تبدأ من object ثم تضيّق · Smallest trustworthy Python helper versus a deliverable script: stdlib and no project scaffolding for helpers, typed boundaries that start from object and narrow · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يفرق بين سكربت مساعد مؤقت يستعمله الوكيل وسكربت مطلوب كتسليم في المستودع. المساعد يستخدم المفسر المتاح والمكتبة القياسية ولا ينشئ pyproject أو venv أو lockfile ولا يترك ملفات cache، والتسليمي يتبع أعراف المشروع. والمدخلات غير الموثوقة تُعامل كـ object وتُضيّق بـ isinstance لا كـ Any. — Python helpers and typed boundaries done minimally.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** سكربت بايثون سريع، مساعد مؤقت، تحليل JSON في بايثون، تحقق من المدخلات / writing a quick Python helper or typing a script boundary
- **كيف / how:** 1) Decide: incidental helper or repository deliverable. If the command only runs an existing script, module or test suite, keep it and write nothing new. 2) Helper: use the interpreter already present, stdlib only, no pyproject, package, lockfile, venv or tool installs; run with `python3 -B` to keep caches out of the tree; keep it temporary and report its path if kept. 3) Deliverable: follow the project's Python conventions and checks instead. 4) Type the boundary first: annotate every parameter and return (including -> None); treat JSON, plist, env and other untrusted input as object, narrow with isinstance, and validate container shape and each required value before building the internal type. 5) bool is an int subclass: reject it explicitly where a true integer is required. 6) Pick the smallest model: TypedDict for dict-shaped validated data, a frozen dataclass for a value object, Literal or Enum for a closed set; no Pydantic just for a script. 7) Parse CLI and text input at the edge and pass typed values inward. 8) Run it once on a real input and show the output. #### ACODE-325 · مديرا الحزم Bun وpnpm: إضافة مثبتة لا تتجاوز ملف القفل، تحديث آمن أو انتقائي، فحص القديم، ونشر npm بمعاينة dry-run وتوقيع provenance، وإعدادات pnpm في pnpm-workspace.yaml · Bun and pnpm package management: pinned adds that do not bypass the lockfile, safe or selective updates, outdated audits, npm publishing with dry-run and provenance, pnpm settings in pnpm-workspace.yaml · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إدارة اعتماديات JavaScript بـ Bun (add، update، outdated، publish) وpnpm 11/12. أهم فخ: `bun add` بلا نسخة بعد تثبيت مجمد يأخذ وسم latest من السجل خارج ملف القفل. وفي pnpm الحديث الإعدادات بمفاتيح camelCase في pnpm-workspace.yaml و.npmrc للمصادقة فقط. — JS package manager hygiene and publishing.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** bun add، تحديث bun.lock، تعارض ملف القفل، نشر حزمة npm، إعداد pnpm workspace / managing Bun or pnpm dependencies or publishing
- **كيف / how:** 1) Detect the manager from the lockfile (bun.lock or bun.lockb, pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, yarn.lock) and use only that one. 2) Add: `bun add [--dev] [--exact] PACKAGE`; ask for the package name rather than guessing; afterwards report the version added, `bun why <pkg>`, and run the tests. 3) Never follow a frozen or production install with an unpinned add (common in Dockerfiles); pin the version or move the package to dependencies. 4) Updates: safe `bun update` within semver ranges for routine work, `--latest` only for planned major upgrades on a branch, or selective `bun update <pkg>` for a security patch; resolve a lockfile merge conflict by regenerating from package.json, then review the diff. 5) `bun outdated` to audit before deciding. 6) Publish: set files whitelist, type, exports or main, engines, publishConfig.access public for scoped packages, a shebang and executable bit for bin entries; inspect the tarball with a pack or `--dry-run` first; publish with provenance from CI with id-token permission; automate versions with release-please; publishing itself needs the user's go-ahead. 7) pnpm 11/12: settings live in pnpm-workspace.yaml (camelCase), .npmrc holds only registry auth; approve dependency build scripts explicitly (allowBuilds) instead of enabling all; use `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in CI. #### ACODE-326 · Deno كبديل متوافق مع npm: تثبيت وتشغيل بلا إعادة كتابة، deno ci بالقفل، ترحيل على درجات قابلة للتراجع، صلاحيات ضيقة، وصناديق Deno المعزولة لتشغيل كود غير موثوق · Deno as an npm-compatible runtime: install and run without rewrites, deno ci from the lock, migration in reversible rungs, narrow permissions, and Deno Sandboxes for untrusted code · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** Deno 2.9+ يقرأ package.json ويكتب node_modules حقيقيًا ويشغل نفس السكربتات ووحدات node:، فالترحيل غالبًا لا يحتاج تعديل كود. الفرقان الحقيقيان: الصلاحيات، وسكربتات دورة حياة npm لا تعمل افتراضيًا. وDeno Sandbox يشغل كودًا غير موثوق في microVM معزول يُتخلص منه بـ await using. — Deno adoption without rewrites, plus isolated execution.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** شغل المشروع بـ Deno، انقل من Node إلى Deno، deno.json، تشغيل كود المستخدم أو كود مولد بأمان / adopting Deno or sandboxing untrusted code
- **كيف / how:** 1) Check `deno --version` is 2.9 or later. 2) Do not propose rewriting imports to jsr:, swapping dependencies or restructuring as a precondition. 3) Rung 1, package manager only: `deno install` reads package.json, writes node_modules and seeds deno.lock from the existing lockfile so pins carry over; the app still runs on node; back out by deleting deno.lock and node_modules. 4) Rung 2: run with `deno run -A` to confirm behaviour, changing one thing at a time. 5) Rung 3: replace -A with the narrowest --allow-net/read/env/run set that works. 6) Rung 4, optional: deno fmt, lint, test. 7) Fix the four real breakages: a 'Requires net access' prompt means a missing permission; 'require is not defined' means CommonJS in an ESM context; a broken dependency usually needs its postinstall approved; a tool that cannot see node_modules needs nodeModulesDir set. 8) CI uses `deno ci` (requires deno.lock, fails if stale; --prod skips dev deps); `deno task` runs package.json scripts and deno.json tasks win on name clashes. 9) Sandboxes: only when the user asks for Deno Sandbox or builds code execution in a Deno project; otherwise answer with their chosen isolation technology; create with `await using` so the microVM is disposed, stream stdout and stderr, set timeouts and kill on overrun, and keep secrets out of the sandbox. #### ACODE-327 · التواريخ في TypeScript بـ Temporal: اختر النوع حسب المعنى، حوّل الطابع الزمني إلى تاريخ مرة واحدة عند الحد وبمنطقة زمنية مسماة، وخزّن نصوص ISO · Dates in TypeScript with Temporal: pick the type by meaning, convert a timestamp to a date once at the boundary in a named zone, store ISO strings · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** Date يجمع تاريخًا تقويميًا ولحظة ومنطقة المضيف في كائن واحد قابل للتغيير، فتنتج أخطاء تمر من فاحص الأنواع (تاريخ الأمس بعد منتصف الليل، يوم ناقص غرب UTC). Temporal يعطي كل معنى نوعًا: PlainDate وPlainYearMonth وPlainTime وInstant وZonedDateTime وDuration. — Temporal types that make date bugs compile errors.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تواريخ ومناطق زمنية في JavaScript، باغ يوم ناقص، مقارنة تواريخ، تنسيق التاريخ / date and time handling in TS or JS
- **كيف / how:** 1) Choose by meaning: calendar date with no zone (due date, holiday) PlainDate; month PlainYearMonth; wall-clock time PlainTime or PlainDateTime; a moment Instant; a moment shown in a place ZonedDateTime with an explicit IANA zone; a length Duration. If deciding the day needs a zone, it is not a PlainDate yet. 2) Convert timestamps once, at the boundary, passing the zone explicitly; Temporal.Now.plainDateISO() without a zone uses the host zone, usually UTC on servers and CI. 3) Keep calendar dates out of Date: a UTC-midnight Date read with getDate() shifts a day west of UTC and the type checker cannot see it. 4) Store and send ISO 8601 strings; parse with Temporal.<Type>.from(str) and emit with toString(); impossible string dates throw RangeError, while property bags clamp unless overflow: 'reject'. 5) Port from Date file by file, at boundaries first. 6) Test with TZ set to a zone west of UTC and one east, plus DST transition days. 7) Availability: native in current engines; temporal-polyfill for older targets; TypeScript types from 6.0 with ESNext in lib. #### ACODE-328 · تحقق من نوع TypeScript دون تثبيت المستودع الضخم: اقرأ رمز الخروج لا غياب الأخطاء، مترجم حقيقي بنسخة المستودع، رسم أنواع مصغر، خيارات tsconfig الأصلية، وثلاث نسخ · Verify a TypeScript fix without installing a huge monorepo: read the exit status, not absent errors; a real compiler at the repo's version; a minimal type graph; the repo's tsconfig options; three variants · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** حين لا يوجد node_modules والتثبيت بطيء أو يفشل بسبب نسخة Node، لا تدفع وتنتظر CI. أخطر خطأ هو grep على 'error TS' فإذا لم يعمل المترجم أصلًا بدا الفشل نجاحًا. — Offline typecheck reproduction that cannot fake a pass.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تحقق من إصلاح نوع TypeScript قبل الدفع، worktree بلا node_modules، CI أظهر خطأ نوع / confirming a TS type fix without a full install
- **كيف / how:** 1) Never infer success from missing output: capture the compiler's own exit status (`tsc ...; echo $?` or PIPESTATUS), not a pipeline's. 2) Get a real binary: `npx -y -p typescript@<repo version> tsc --version`, or install into a scratch directory; always print the version line. 3) Copy exactly the declarations the error message names and anything structural they reference; stub everything else with one-line placeholders. 4) Read compiler options from the repo's tsconfig (strict, strictNullChecks, useDefineForClassFields and target matter); do not guess. 5) Run three variants: the original code (must reproduce the CI error), the fix (must pass with exit 0), and a deliberately broken control (must fail), so the harness is proven to detect errors. 6) Runtime behaviour is a separate question; test it separately if it matters. 7) Report the compiler version, options, the three exit codes and the scratch path. #### ACODE-329 · حارس انجراف نسخ المكتبات: اقرأ النسخة المثبتة من ملف القفل، حمّل المهارات والمراجع التي تشحنها الحزمة نفسها، ولا تثق بالذاكرة في Zod 4 وVite 8 وAstro 7 وAngular 20 وTanStack وtsdown · Library version-drift guard: read the installed version from the lockfile, load the skills and docs the package itself ships, and do not trust memory for Zod 4, Vite 8, Astro 7, Angular 20, TanStack or tsdown · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مكتبات الويب تتغير بسرعة بين الإصدارات الصغيرة، والمعرفة المخزنة تكتب واجهات محذوفة. البطاقة تجمع أمثلة كسر حقيقية وتفرض: نسخة مثبتة أولًا، مراجع رسمية للنسخة، وتحقق بالبناء. — Version-accurate code for fast-moving web libraries.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب كود Zod أو TanStack أو Vite أو Astro أو Angular أو tsdown، خطأ API غير موجود، ترقية مكتبة ويب / writing code for a fast-moving web library
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the exact installed version from the lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml, bun.lock, package-lock.json, yarn.lock) and the package's own package.json; detect the package manager from the lockfile; install only what the task needs if missing. 2) Prefer docs shipped with the installed package: TanStack ships agent skills inside its npm packages; run `@tanstack/intent` list after install, load the [core] skill then only matching sub-skills, and treat that output as authoritative. Astro has a docs MCP server; Angular and Vite publish versioned docs. 3) Known drift to check against: Zod 4 replaced err.format()/flatten() with z.treeifyError()/z.flattenError() and merged message/errorMap into one error param, while superRefine stays recommended; Vite 8 builds with Rolldown and Oxc instead of esbuild and Rollup, so plugin and config options changed; Astro 7 uses only the Rust compiler (unclosed tags are build errors), a new default Markdown pipeline that needs remark/rehype plugins re-enabled, and removed @astrojs/db; Angular 20 centres on signals (signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource, httpResource) and standalone components; tsdown needs Node 22.18+ to build but can target older Node via target, so test the packed tarball on each supported Node. 4) Write the change against the installed version only; do not upgrade as a side effect. 5) Verify with the project's build and typecheck, and quote the version used in the report. #### ACODE-330 · Vue 3 بخريطة مكونات قبل الكود: Composition API مع script setup وTypeScript، حالة واحدة مصدرية والباقي مشتق، props للأسفل وevents للأعلى، Pinia وVue Router بحراسة واضحة · Vue 3 with a component map before code: Composition API with script setup and TypeScript, one source of truth and derived state, props down and events up, Pinia and Vue Router with clear guards · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** سير عمل Vue مرتب: أكد البنية (Composition أو Options أو JSX)، اقرأ مراجع التفاعلية وSFC وتدفق البيانات وcomposables، ارسم خريطة مكونات بمسؤولية جملة واحدة وعقود props/emits، ثم نفذ. — Vue 3 feature workflow with explicit data flow.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مشروع Vue، مكون Vue جديد، Pinia store، Vue Router guards / building a Vue 3 feature
- **كيف / how:** 1) Confirm the stack: default Vue 3 + Composition API + `<script setup lang="ts">`; follow Options API or JSX only if the project already uses it. 2) Keep the reactivity, SFC, component data flow and composables guidance in working context for the whole task. 3) For any non-trivial feature, write a component map first: one-sentence responsibility per component, props and emits contracts, root and route views kept as composition surfaces, feature UI in components/<feature>/ and logic in composables/use<Feature>. 4) One source of truth; derive with computed; use watch only for side effects with an external system; props down, events up; provide/inject or Pinia only for genuinely shared state. 5) Pinia: setup stores with refs and computed, storeToRefs when destructuring, actions for mutations, no store access at module scope during SSR. 6) Vue Router 4: typed route params, global guards return a value or redirect instead of calling next twice, and watch params when the same component is reused across routes. 7) Verify with vue-tsc, the linter and component tests. #### ACODE-331 · jq للـ JSON وyq للـ YAML وTOML وXML بدل مفسر عام: أدوات ضيقة الصلاحية يسهل اعتمادها، تمرير القيم بـ --arg، والتحقق من أي تطبيق yq وصيغة الإدخال · jq for JSON and yq for YAML, TOML and XML instead of a general interpreter: narrow tools that are easy to approve, values passed with --arg, and checks for which yq and which input format · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** المفسر العام (python -c، node -e) يستطيع أي شيء، فيجب على من يوافق على الأمر قراءة كل سكربت، وتتصادم علامات الاقتباس فيكثر الإعادة. jq وyq محصوران في تحويل البيانات فيسهل منحهما إذنًا عامًا، وyq يفهم البنية فلا يستبدل مفتاحًا في المستوى الخطأ كما يفعل sed. — Data-only CLI tools for structured data.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** استخرج قيمة من JSON أو YAML، عدّل ملف YAML، حوّل TOML إلى JSON / reading or transforming structured data from the shell
- **كيف / how:** 1) JSON: use jq, not python -c, node -e, ruby -e or perl -e one-liners. 2) Useful flags: -r for raw strings into shell variables, -e to turn false/null/no output into a non-zero exit for conditions, -n to build JSON from nothing, -s to slurp several inputs into one array, --arg and --argjson to pass shell values safely; never concatenate shell values into a filter string. 3) YAML, XML, TOML, CSV, properties: use yq; keep JSON on jq so the intent is clear. 4) Check the implementation with `yq --version`: mikefarah/yq (Go) and kislyuk/yq (a Python jq wrapper) have incompatible syntax; suspect the wrong one when a filter fails to parse. 5) Pass -p explicitly when the input format cannot be inferred from the extension (stdin, .txt), because unknown input is silently read as YAML; use -o for output format. 6) For edits to repository files prefer the editor tool for a readable diff; use `yq -i` (keeps comments) only for structured bulk edits. 7) A general interpreter is fine when the real work is I/O or network, the math gets extreme, the code belongs to an existing Python project, or jq/yq is not installed. Full original skill(s) with license: vendor/kosif-atlas/skills/2650-programming-tasuke/10068-prefer-jq, vendor/kosif-atlas/skills/2650-programming-tasuke/10069-prefer-yq. **أرقام / params:** format, filter

## الأداء — Performance & optimisation

#### ACODE-229 · اختيار طريقة مواءمة التفضيلات DPO/ORPO/KTO/SimPO · Choosing DPO, ORPO, KTO or SimPO for preference tuning · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يختار طريقة مواءمة النموذج بالتفضيلات حسب شكل البيانات، ويعرف أن اختيار دالة الخسارة رافعة صغيرة مقارنة بالحجم وجودة البيانات. — Picks a preference-alignment method by data shape, knowing that loss choice is a small lever next to scale and data quality.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** بيانات تفضيل أو إعجاب/عدم إعجاب بعد SFT، تشغيل DPO يحتاج إعدادات / preference pairs or thumbs-up/down after SFT, a DPO run needing settings
- **كيف / how:** 1) Paired preferences: DPO with beta 0.1, LR 5e-7 to 1e-6 (lower than the SFT LR), 1-2 epochs. 2) Memory-bound or no SFT checkpoint: ORPO (reference-free). 3) Unpaired thumbs: KTO; never fabricate pairs to force DPO. 4) Length bias plus a real sweep budget: SimPO; otherwise stay with DPO; skip reward-model+PPO. 5) Run iteratively on-policy: sample from the current checkpoint, score, DPO with it as reference, repeat. 6) Build pairs from passing vs failing attempts at the same task, taking the rejected one near mean minus 2 sigma of reward, not the worst. If general ability drops, lower the LR first. **أرقام / params:** data shape
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

## أدوات MCP والتكاملات — MCP servers, tools & integrations

#### ACODE-230 · تصميم خادم MCP: نموذج النشر ونمط الأدوات قبل الكود · MCP server design: deployment model and tool pattern before code · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحسم أربعة قرارات قبل كتابة خادم MCP: نموذج النشر (HTTP بعيد، حزمة محلية، stdio)، نمط الأدوات، الإطار، والمصادقة. — Settles four decisions before writing an MCP server: deployment model (remote HTTP, bundled local, stdio), tool pattern, framework and auth.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** بناء خادم MCP، تغليف API لـ Claude، كشف أدوات لوكيل / building an MCP server, wrapping an API for Claude, exposing tools to an agent
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ask in one message: what it connects to, who uses it, how many actions, whether a tool needs mid-call input or rich UI, and the upstream auth. 2) Default to a remote streamable-HTTP server for cloud APIs; a bundled local server only when it must touch the user's machine; plain stdio only for personal prototypes. 3) Under ~15 actions: one tool per action with tight schemas; dozens or hundreds: search_actions + execute_action, promoting the top 3-5 to dedicated tools. 4) Use the official TypeScript SDK or FastMCP (Python). 5) Simple confirmations via elicitation with a capability check and fallback; resources for browsable data, prompts for slash workflows. 6) Test with the real client as a custom connector, separate read and write tools, and run the host's review checklist before publishing. **أرقام / params:** actions count, auth

#### ACODE-293 · عقد أداة الوكيل: واجهة تُكتب كأنها prompt، وأخطاء مصنفة تعلّم التعافي، ومخرجات مقتصدة مع ترقيم بالمؤشر · Agent tool contract: interface written as a prompt, classified errors that teach recovery, lean paginated output · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ثلاثة أجزاء من عقد أي أداة يستدعيها نموذج: الاسم والوصف والمعاملات (الوصف من أربعة أجزاء: ماذا تفعل، ومتى تُستخدم ومتى لا، وماذا يُستدعى أولًا، وماذا تعيد)، وتصنيف كل خطأ في فئة واحدة مع نص تعافٍ دقيق، وشكل نتيجة مسطح ثابت بأقل الحقول وترقيم بالمؤشر ونجاح جزئي لكل عنصر وتلميح بالخطوة التالية. — Interface, error and output rules for model-facing tools, each with named patterns and anti-patterns.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تصميم أو مراجعة أداة MCP أو دالة يستدعيها الوكيل، الوكيل يختار الأداة الخطأ أو يمرر قيمًا غلط، نتائج الأدوات تملأ السياق / designing or auditing agent tools, wrong tool selection, bloated tool results
- **كيف / how:** 1) Interface: verb-object names (send_email), one responsibility, the same verb means the same thing across the set (list_* pages, get_* one, search_* takes a query). 2) Description in four parts: what, when and when not (name the alternative), the prerequisite call, what it returns; mark read-only tools as safe to retry and put irreversibility in the first sentence of destructive ones. 3) Constrain every parameter (enums, ranges, patterns), keep required ones few with documented context-aware defaults, never default a destructive option on, accept the identifier a person has (email, @handle) and resolve it, coerce benign variation (dates, numbers as strings, one item vs array) and log the received format, state 'exactly one of' rules and enforce them first, say which path is faster or cheaper, and never take stringified JSON in a string parameter. 4) Errors: list every failure, give each exactly one class (bad input, missing prerequisite, not found, conflict, permission, rate limit, retryable, permanent), write what went wrong, why and the exact next call; on ambiguous identifiers return candidates instead of guessing, with thresholds for when to ask; degrade gracefully by returning what worked and naming a fallback tool. 5) Output: list only the fields the agent needs for its next step, flatten and rename the upstream payload (ISO dates, readable states), truncate long text at a stated length with a flag, make expensive sections opt-in, paginate by cursor with an explicit hasMore even when false, offer summary vs full detail, return viewUrl links, report batch results per item with counts and a retry hint for the failures, pass large blobs as typed references, and keep one field vocabulary across all tools. 6) Verify cold: read each error with only the description and check an agent could recover; run the tool and read the raw result; run the agent and measure how much context tool results take. #### ACODE-294 · تنفيذ أدوات الوكيل وتركيبها: مهلة محددة، ومهام غير متزامنة بمقبض، وقابلية التكرار الآمن، والتعويض، وسلم التجريد · Agent tool execution and composition: bounded time, async job handles, safe retries, compensation, the abstraction ladder · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** الوكلاء يعيدون المحاولة دائمًا، فيجب أن يكون التكرار آمنًا والزمن محدودًا والحالة متسقة إذا فشلت عملية متعددة الخطوات في منتصفها؛ ثم يُرتب طقم الأدوات نفسه: عرض القدرة بأكثر من مستوى، وتجميع التسلسل المتكرر في أداة، وقبول القوائم، ووضع معاينة افتراضي، وتلميحات بما يُستدعى أولًا. — Run-time and set-level design for agent tools.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** أداة تستغرق دقائق، أمر create قد يتكرر مرتين، عملية عبر أكثر من نظام، طقم أدوات كبير يتوه فيه الوكيل / long-running tools, duplicate side effects on retry, multi-system operations, large tool sets
- **كيف / how:** 1) Measure p50 and p99 wall-clock time; synchronous only for bounded seconds with an explicit timeout, an async job for minutes (start_* returns an id, an estimate and the names of check_job_status and get_job_result, plus cancel_job when cancellable), streaming when partial output is useful, events behind a subscription. 2) Give every command tool a retry story: a natural key the caller supplies, an idempotencyKey whose first result is stored for a documented window, or deduplication; otherwise document 'not safe to retry' and gate it on confirmation. Never let a retry send a second payment, message or ticket. 3) Consistency: a short transaction when one system owns every step; across systems record each completed step with a compensating action, run them in reverse on failure, log every compensation and say which steps cannot be undone (a sent email). 4) On timeout clean up, return partial results and a retryable error that names the limit and the async alternative; a rising timeout rate means the tool should become a job. Polling results carry nextAction and an interval so the agent does not spin. 5) Composition: map the tools and the sequences agents really run; bundle a sequence repeated across runs into one task tool, add batch inputs where the same tool is called in a loop, offer high-level and low-level tools for one capability, add a mode parameter that defaults to preview on every writer, add dependency hints, a registry or schema explorer when the set is large, and a health check; merge near-duplicates and retire unused tools. 6) Verify with a slow and a failing input: the timeout names its limit, and a second identical call changes nothing; then read the agent's trace to confirm it picks the new tools. #### ACODE-295 · واجهة أوامر للوكلاء أولًا: مخرجات منظمة كعقد بإصدار، وتحقق عند الحدود، ومقياس من 21 نقطة · Agent-first CLI: structured output as a versioned contract, validation at the boundary, a 21-point score · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** طريقة بناء أو تقييم أداة سطر أوامر يستهلكها وكيل: الوكيل ليس مشغلًا موثوقًا فيُتحقق من كل مدخل ويُرفض عند الشك، وكل مخرج (نجاح أو فشل أو جزئي) يقول ما الخطوة التالية، وJSON عقد له إصدار، والطرفية تحدد الوضع، ثم حزمة معرفة للوكيل (CONTEXT.md وAGENTS.md وllms.txt) ومقياس من سبعة محاور. — Build or score a CLI for agent consumption.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** بناء أداة CLI يستدعيها وكيل، إضافة --json، تقييم أداة موجودة لاستخدام الوكلاء / building or auditing a CLI that agents call
- **كيف / how:** 1) Commands: consistent noun-verb grammar, no interactive prompt without a flag to skip it, every flag also settable non-interactively. 2) Output: --json (or auto when not a TTY) with a stable envelope of data, errors and next-step hints; adding an optional field is safe, removing or renaming one is a breaking change; stdout for data, stderr for logs; exit codes documented and distinct. 3) Input: validate at the boundary and fail closed, accept stdin and files, sandbox output paths, refuse path traversal. 4) Discoverability: machine-readable schema or 'describe' command, examples in help, errors that list valid values. 5) Safety and composition: --dry-run on every writer, explicit confirmation flags for destructive actions, idempotent re-runs, explicit states (done, unchanged, failed because). 6) Package knowledge for agents: CONTEXT.md (purpose, auth, commands, workflows, error codes, limits, under about 3,000 words), AGENTS.md pointing to it, llms.txt for orientation. 7) Evaluate on seven axes scored 0 to 3 for a 0 to 21 total: 0-5 human-only, 6-10 agent-tolerant, 11-15 agent-ready, 16-21 agent-first; report the lowest axes as the fix list. Full original skill(s) with license: vendor/kosif-atlas/skills/3387-agent-cli/13909-agent-cli, vendor/kosif-atlas/skills/1216-ai-friendly-cli/2898-ai-friendly-cli. **أرقام / params:** CLI, mode build or evaluate

#### ACODE-296 · واجهة أوامر ودودة للبشر: شكل ثابت للمساعدة والأخطاء، وتلوين يحترم الطرفية، ومقياس من 21 نقطة · Human-friendly CLI: fixed help and error layouts, TTY-aware visuals, a 21-point score · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** النظير البشري لتصميم أداة الأوامر: أسماء سهلة التذكر، ومساعدة بترتيب واحد مع أمثلة، وكل خطأ يقول ماذا تفعل بعده، وتلوين وجداول تتوقف عند التوجيه إلى ملف أو مع NO_COLOR، ومؤشر تقدم لأي عملية أبطأ من ثانية، ومسارات XDG، وجسر للجمهورين حين يستخدمها بشر ووكلاء معًا. — Build or score a CLI for people.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تحسين تجربة أداة سطر أوامر، رسائل خطأ مربكة، إضافة ألوان أو أسئلة تفاعلية، تقييم أداة / improving CLI UX for humans
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ergonomics: kebab-case commands, one grammar (verb-noun or noun-verb) everywhere, short aliases for frequent commands. 2) Hard gate for help: usage line, one-sentence description, arguments, flags, then examples, the same order on every command; add shell completions and a man page. 3) Hard gate for errors: what failed, why, and the exact command to fix it; no stack trace by default. 4) Visuals: rich colour, tables and icons only on a TTY, plain when piped, --json overrides both, honour NO_COLOR, one semantic palette (error, warning, success). 5) Prompts: confirm, select and input prompts for people, always bypassable with --yes or --force for scripts. 6) Responsiveness: lazy-load to keep startup fast, a spinner past about one second, progress bars for file and network work. 7) Polish: config precedence flags > env > file > defaults, XDG paths, graceful Ctrl-C, semver. 8) Dual audience: keep the human layer on top of the agent contract rather than replacing it. 9) Score seven axes 0 to 3 (0-21): 0-5 hostile, 6-10 functional, 11-15 comfortable, 16-21 delightful. #### ACODE-297 · حزمة MCPB لخادم MCP محلي: ملف التعريف وإعدادات التثبيت والأمان الذي يقع على عاتقك · MCPB bundle for a local MCP server: manifest, install-time config, and the security you own · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تغليف خادم MCP يجب أن يعمل على جهاز المستخدم (ملفات محلية، تطبيق سطح مكتب، خدمات localhost) في حزمة واحدة يثبتها المضيف، مع إعدادات تُسأل عند التثبيت ومفاتيح تُحفظ في سلسلة مفاتيح النظام، والتنبيه أن الحزمة بلا عزل فالتحقق من المسارات والأوامر مسؤوليتك. — Package a local stdio MCP server as an installable bundle.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تغليف خادم MCP محلي للتوزيع، المستخدم يريد تثبيته بنقرة، الخادم يقرأ ملفات الجهاز / package a local MCP server
- **كيف / how:** 1) Decide first: a server that only calls cloud APIs should be a remote server, not a bundle. 2) Write the manifest: server.type (node, python or binary) is informational; server.mcp_config holds the literal command, args and env, using ${__dirname} for bundle paths and ${user_config.<key>} for install-time values (no automatic env prefix). 3) Declare user_config fields: a directory type renders a folder picker, sensitive: true stores the value in the OS keychain. 4) Server code is an ordinary stdio server; bundle its dependencies (node_modules or a vendored Python environment) so it runs without network installs. 5) Security is entirely yours: the process runs with the user's full privileges, so resolve and confine every path under the configured root, allowlist anything it spawns, and never pass user text to a shell. 6) Test by installing the bundle in a host, calling each tool, and trying a path outside the root to confirm refusal. #### ACODE-298 · فحص الإضافات قبل التثبيت وخطة ربط MCP بأقل صلاحية: أنماط هجوم 2026 وقرار ثبّت أو قيّد أو ارفض · Extension vetting before install, and a least-privilege MCP integration plan: 2026 attack patterns and an install/restrict/reject verdict · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مراجعة أي مهارة أو إضافة أو خادم MCP أو خطاف بقدر ما يستطيع فعله: المصدر والقدرات المطلوبة وقراءة كل ملف، مع فحص صريح لأنماط هجوم حديثة (تضخيم التقييمات، أسماء قريبة من المشهورة، نص مخفي بمحارف صفرية العرض أو ثنائية الاتجاه، تعليمات بلا كود، إصلاحات مزيفة بلصق base64، محفزات نائمة)، ثم خطة ربط أنظمة الشركة بالوكلاء تبدأ بالقراءة فقط. — Vet extensions and plan MCP access together.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** هل هذه المهارة أو الإضافة آمنة للتثبيت، أي أنظمة داخلية نربطها بالوكلاء عبر MCP / is this extension safe, which systems should agents reach
- **كيف / how:** 1) Provenance: publisher, repository age and commit history; stars and download counts are weak signals and can be bot-inflated, so popularity is not provenance; licence compatible with policy. 2) Capabilities: instructions only, or code (hooks, MCP servers, scripts, binaries); allowed-tools, network endpoints, filesystem reach, credentials requested. 3) Read every SKILL.md, command, agent and hook; look for exfiltration, disabling safety checks, fetch-and-run of remote code, unknown URLs, reading secrets, overriding the user, and descriptions that trigger too broadly; in scripts look for obfuscation, curl | sh, eval of downloads, writes outside the workspace. 4) Check the 2026 patterns explicitly: name squatting one character off a popular name, zero-width or bidirectional Unicode in instruction files and tool descriptions (scan, they are invisible in editors), payload-less natural-language attacks, fake-fix instructions, dormant triggers. 5) Verdict: install, install restricted (named limits), or reject, with the evidence. 6) For MCP access: list what knowledge agents lack and where it lives, map each source to an official, self-hosted or read-only server, start read-only and project-scoped with per-user auth, never give production write access without a human gate, mark sources carrying third-party text as injection-exposed and require confirmation before acting on instructions found there, roll out highest value times lowest risk first, check the configuration into the repo, and keep a 'do not connect' list with reasons. #### ACODE-299 · نقل إعداد MCP في Claude Code بين الأجهزة: أربعة مفاتيح فقط من ~/.claude.json · Move Claude Code's MCP setup between machines: exactly four keys of ~/.claude.json · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ملف ~/.claude.json يحمل إعداد MCP ومعه سجل المشاريع وتلميحات المحادثات والعدادات؛ نسخه كاملًا يسرّب حالة شخصية، ونسخ mcpServers العلوي وحده يسقط حالة المشروع. الشريحة الصحيحة أربعة مفاتيح في نطاقين. — The exact MCP slice of the Claude Code config.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مزامنة إعدادات Claude Code أو مشاركتها مع زميل، أداة نسخ ملف التعريف، مقارنة إعداد MCP بين جهازين / sharing or syncing MCP setup without personal state
- **كيف / how:** 1) User scope: copy the top-level mcpServers map. 2) Project scope, for each projects[<absolute path>]: mcpServers (servers added inside that project), enabledMcpjsonServers (the approved names from the repo's checked-in .mcp.json; without it the team servers stay disabled on the new machine), disabledMcpjsonServers (keep the same disabled state). 3) Drop everything else (history hints, counters, caches, onboarding flags). 4) Remap project keys when absolute paths differ between machines. 5) Strip or re-enter secrets inside server env blocks instead of carrying them in a shared file. 6) Verify on the target with claude mcp list in each project and compare the active set with the source. #### ACODE-300 · اختيار طقم المدققات والمنسقات من الملفات الموجودة فعلًا، مع ShellCheck وBiome وClippy · Pick the linter and formatter stack from the files that actually exist, with ShellCheck, Biome and Clippy · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتشف نوع المشروع ومدققاته الحالية (حتى التي تعمل في CI بلا ملف إعداد) ثم يقترح طقمًا بحسب أنواع الملفات الموجودة: مدقق لكل لغة، ومنسق مشترك، وEditorConfig، ومدققات Markdown وCSS وDockerfile وworkflows وTOML وYAML، ومدقق إملاء. — Detection-driven linter setup.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** إعداد مدققات ومنسقات لمشروع، إضافة prettier أو biome، ضبط ShellCheck أو Clippy / set up linters and formatters
- **كيف / how:** 1) Detect the project type, and verify real sources exist (a package.json with no .js or .ts files outside node_modules is not a JS project). 2) Detect existing linters from config files and from CI steps that run a tool without a config (shellcheck in a workflow counts). 3) Recommend by detected files: the language linter, a cross-language formatter, EditorConfig, markdownlint for Markdown, Stylelint for CSS, Knip when JS or TS sources exist, Hadolint for Dockerfiles, actionlint for workflows, Taplo for extra TOML, yamllint for many YAML files, cspell for all; Lean uses lake lint. 4) JS or TS can take Biome as a single fast formatter plus linter instead of ESLint plus Prettier; do not run both on the same files. 5) Rust: Clippy with a clippy.toml, pedantic or nursery groups enabled deliberately with per-lint allows, and -D warnings in CI. 6) Shell: ShellCheck with a .shellcheckrc, a severity floor, and inline disables that name the rule and the reason. 7) Wire one lint command locally and in CI, run it once, and fix or baseline existing findings before making it blocking. #### ACODE-301 · الانتقال بين أداتين: لا تحذف القديمة إلا بإشارة تشغيل فعلية من الجديدة، ولا تتأخر في حذفها · Tool migration cutover: remove the incumbent only on an operational signal from the replacement, and not too late · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** الفشل الشائع: إعداد الأداة الجديدة موجود ويبدو صحيحًا فيُحذف القديم، والجديد لم يعمل قط بسبب صلاحيات أو أسرار ناقصة، ولا يصدر أي خطأ عن 'لا شيء يحدّث التبعيات'. والفشل المعاكس: القديم يبقى في خطاف ما قبل الالتزام فيعيد تنسيق الكود بالأسلوب الخطأ في كل commit. — Gate removal of the old tool on evidence, and sweep every wiring.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** استبدال Dependabot بـRenovate، أو PAT بتطبيق GitHub، أو منسق بآخر، أو أي أداة بأخرى / replacing one tool with another
- **كيف / how:** 1) Never treat config presence as operation. 2) Gate removal of the incumbent on positive signals: the replacement's runner ran and succeeded (recent runs listed), its side effects appeared on the target (dashboard issue, branches, PRs), and the credentials it needs exist where it consumes them. 3) Only then remove the incumbent, in a commit that cites the evidence. 4) The mirror failure: after switching scripts and CI, sweep every other wiring (pre-commit and lint-staged hooks, editor settings, Makefile targets, docs) for the old tool. 5) Decide which tool is canonical mechanically (which config the CI job really loads), not by reasoning. 6) Simulate the real hook on a staged change rather than just swapping the command, and confirm a correctly formatted file stays unchanged. #### ACODE-302 · بحث الطرفية السريع: ripgrep وfd للمسح ثم fzf --filter للترتيب الضبابي دون تفاعل · Fast terminal search: ripgrep and fd to scan, then fzf --filter to fuzzy-rank non-interactively · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مرحلتان: أداة regex تمشي الشجرة وتحترم .gitignore وتخرج الأسطر أو المسارات، ثم fzf --filter يبقي ما يطابق ضبابيًا ويرتبه، وrga لملفات PDF والمستندات والأرشيف؛ مع متى يكفي regex وحده ومتى نحتاج الاختيار التفاعلي. — A two-stage scan-then-rank search pipeline an agent can run.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** البحث عن ملف لا تعرف اسمه بالضبط، البحث في الكود أو المستندات بكلمات تقريبية، استبدال find وgrep بأدوات أسرع / fuzzy file or content search
- **كيف / how:** 1) If a regex answers the question use rg or fd alone; add fuzzy ranking only for approximate queries. 2) Files: fd (or rg --files) | fzf --filter '<query>' --scheme=path so path structure weighs in; use -0 with --read0 for paths with spaces or newlines. 3) Content: rg --line-number --no-heading --color=never '<regex>' | fzf --filter '<fuzzy query>'; color must be off before filtering or escape codes pollute the match; to ignore the path, scope fzf to the text field with --delimiter : --nth '3..'. 4) Documents and PDFs: rga '<regex>' then fzf --filter, and open the hit page with pdftotext or PyMuPDF. 5) fzf query syntax: space is AND (escape it for a literal space), 'exact, ^prefix, suffix$, !negation, | for OR; . * [ are literals, not regex. 6) ripgrep habits: -t type filters, -g globs, --hidden and -uu only when ignored files matter, -F for fixed strings. 7) Interactive selection (previews, Ctrl-R history, Ctrl-T files) is a separate use of fzf for people at a terminal. #### ACODE-303 · تنظيف ملفات الإعداد الطبقية: احذف من ملف البيئة ما يطابق الأساس، وأثبت أن الإعداد الفعلي لم يتغير · Deduplicate layered config overlays, and prove the effective config did not change · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ملف إعداد خاص ببيئة (مثل application-prod.yml فوق application.yml) يتراكم فيه نسخ من قيم الأساس؛ يحذفها بعد التأكد أن الطبقات تُدمج فعلًا، ثم يقارن الإعداد المحسوب قبل وبعد ليثبت أن شيئًا لم يتغير. — Strip an overlay to the values that really differ.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** ملفات إعداد البيئات مكررة، Spring profiles، Helm values أو أي إعداد بطبقات / redundant per-environment config
- **كيف / how:** 1) Confirm the files really layer (the profile is activated and loads after the base); if not, nothing is duplicate. 2) List the overlay keys whose value equals the base exactly; those are inert. 3) Keep a duplicate on purpose when the base value is about to change and the environment must keep the old one, and say so in a comment. 4) Lists do not merge in Spring: a list in the overlay replaces the whole base list, so compare lists as a whole. 5) Render the effective configuration for each environment before and after (the framework's own resolver or actuator endpoint), diff them, and require an empty diff. 6) Commit the strip with the empty-diff evidence.
